digimons.name: Algomon (Baby I)
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Baby Digimon that was born from a bug in an algorithm. It has a habit of finding and converging on places where high-capacity data leaks. They gather one by one, and form hordes and then blanket it.

digimons.name: Bombmon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA short-tempered Digimon that easily blows its top at trivial things. As it loses its temper, its topknot steadily shortens, and when the topknot has completely retracted into its head, its anger explodes. Although it has Special Moves like "Bomberhead", which heaps shock-waves upon the opponent, and "Fireworks Revolution", which scatters particles of various colors, all of them have the power of a firecracker. However, because of its vivid beauty, it is often enjoyed as a party entertainment. It is a nuisance for Bombmon that it is provoked even though it is at a party.

skills.name: Bomberhead
skills.description: Attacks with shockwaves.

skills.name: Fireworks Revolution
skills.description: Scatters particles of various colors that have the power of firecrackers.

digimons.name: Bommon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Slime Digimon which has a bomb-shaped body. The fuse on its tail ignites the moment it hatches from its egg and steadily grows shorter, but because it evolves to the next generation before the fuse disappears, nobody knows what will happen if the fuse went out. It possesses a short-tempered personality, and it's said that when it gets in a bad mood, the progress of the fuse gets faster. Because its fuse's "Bachibachibacchin" sparks produce an intense noise, any opponent would be surprised if they were suddenly produced before their eyes.

skills.name: Bachibachibacchin
skills.description: Makes an intense sound with the spark on its tail to frighten its enemies.

digimons.name: Botamon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Digital Monster that was born just recently. On the surface of its slime-shaped body, it has grown thick, black fuzz. It is unable to battle as it has just been born, but it can produce bubble-like objects from its mouth to intimidate the enemy.

cites.text: Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth Hacker's Memory
Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth Hacker's Memory

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Shoots bubble-like substances from its mouth.

skills.name: Awa
skills.description: Spits out bubbles from its mouth.

digimons.name: Bubbmon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalAlthough it looks like merely pale green bubbles at first glance, it is actually a Bubble Digimon that can move freely and express a plethora of facial expressions. Because its surface has not hardened yet, its defensive power is practically nonexistent and it is unsuited for combat. It produces tiny bubbles which proliferate infinitely from the pacifier-like part it holds in its mouth. This proliferation ability was being used for computer virus development at one point, but because its life force was too weak, that was fortunately never implemented. Although its life is fleeting, it is a lovable Digimon Baby that lives its life to the fullest. Its specialty is escaping while the intruder's movement is restricted by the adhesive bubbles it produces from within its body.

cites.text: Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth Hacker's Memory
Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth Hacker's Memory
Digimon Beatbreak: "A World of Shining Light"
Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth Hacker's Memory

skills.name: Nenchakusei no Awa
skills.description: Releases a sticky bubble to restrict its opponent's movement.

skills.name: Awa
skills.description: Spits out bubbles from its mouth.

cites.text: Digital Monster COLOR Digimon Xros Wars 15th Edition

digimons.name: Chicomon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA small, blue-colored, Dragon Digimon child. Although it is small and powerless, it has the potential to evolve to every Dragon Digimon. For that reason, it is a Digimon that is considered exceedingly valuable by tamers and researchers of Dragon Digimon. It is cherished due to its personality of friendliness and overflowing curiosity, characteristic of Baby Digimon. Just like other Baby Digimon, it spits acidic bubbles to attack, but as usual, their power is nonexistent.

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Spits acidic bubbles.

digimons.name: Choromon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA super-tiny Machine Digimon which has red eyes that act as photosensors. The appearance of it moving around restlessly seems very cute, but because it is carrying nothing but a simple program that moves in reaction to bright lights, if its surroundings go dark it becomes completely unable to move. The reason why is not understood, but when it is in a good mood, it discharges electricity from the tip of its tail. Its Special Move is releasing iron grains to cause temporary disorder in the opponent's AI (Jamming Powder). It flees while the opponent is confused by this technique.

skills.name: Jamming Powder
skills.description: Releases iron grains to cause temporary disorder in the opponent's AI.

digimons.name: Cocomon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalAn extremely rare Digimon, which is born in pairs from a single Digitama. Why only Zerimon and Cocomon are born as twins is currently unknown. What's more, they are not restricted to always being born as twins, and there have been cases where a Zerimon and Cocomon are each born from a single Digitama. Compared to the extremely energetic, one-horned Zerimon, the three-horned Cocomon has a relatively docile personality. Like other Baby Digimon, it spits acid bubbles to intimidate opponents.

cites.text: Digimon Tamers Koushiki Daizukan Vol. VI

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Spits acidic bubbles from its mouth.

digimons.name: Cotsucomon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Digimon that was born already wearing a leather hat. It looks stronger than the average Baby level due to its equipment, but because it is made of a soft material, it barely offers any defensive protection. It is extremely vigilant, and will retreat into its hat at the slightest provocation. Its Special Move is poking at the opponent with the brim of its hat (Kottsun).

skills.name: Kottsun
skills.description: Pokes at the opponent with the brim of its hat.

digimons.name: Curimon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Baby Digimon characterized by the single horn on its brow and its frill. It is so active that before it is even born its Digitama bounces, and after hatching it moves around vigorously. The horn on its brow and the frill on its head are still immature and soft, and although they cannot be used in battle yet, they help it to keep its balance while moving around and protects its body when it bumps into things. It heroically threatens approaching enemies by producing bubbles.

skills.name: Awa
skills.description: Creates bubbles to threaten approaching enemies.

digimons.name: Dodomon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Slime Digimon whose whole body is covered in the tough fur "Mithril Hair". It exhibits an aggressive personality immediately after being born, and despite its fangs not yet being grown, it threatens enemies by opening its mouth wide and doing a biting motion. Because of this behaviour, it often gets defeated by other Digimon, which explains why this Digimon is so rare. If an opponent approaches, it attacks by spitting "Chīsana Tetsuryū" from its mouth.

skills.name: Chīsana Tetsuryū
skills.description: Attacks an opponent that approaches it by spitting small iron beads.

skills.name: Seidenki
skills.description: Emits static electricity from the tip of its horn.

digimons.name: Fufumon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Slime Digimon with an extremely light body that has floated through the air since it was born. When its life is threatened by an assault from a larger opponent, it will thrust at them with the horn on its head to intimidate them with all its might, but because the horn is very soft, the thrust will not injure the opponent. Though it is easy for opponents to target it because it floats very slowly through the air, but if they approach it spit "Chīsana Tetsu no Toge" from its mouth to attack.

skills.name: Chiisana Tetsu no Toge
skills.description: Spits out small iron spikes from its mouth.

digimons.name: Fukamon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA Smoke Digimon with virtually no mass, like a cloud, that floats lightly through the air. It doesn't move that much on its own accord, but since it travels around by going with the wind, it widely inhabits the continent of the Eastern Digital World. On stormy days, it is said to take shelter behind objects or large Digimon so that it doesn't get blown away.



When it senses that it is in danger, it spews out clouds with its "Koun" and then flees.

skills.name: Koun
skills.description: Spews out clouds.

digimons.name: Fusamon
digimons.description: A Slime Digimon whose whole body is covered in soft fur. Although it is a Digimon brimming with curiosity that loves to move around, it spends most of its time sleeping due to it tiring easily. When danger draws near, it will emit a high-pitched, threatening cry called "Puppy Noise".

skills.name: Puppy Noise
skills.description: Emits a high-pitched, threatening cry.

digimons.name: Jyarimon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalAn extremely scarce Digimon, whose population is small. The Babies of Dragon-species Digimon are small in absolute number, and it is said that most of them are captured or die before they grow up. You wouldn't know it to look at it, but there are tiny, closely packed fangs growing within its mouth, and it is foreseen that it will grow into a powerful Dragon-species Digimon. Although it is powerless, it has the disposition to face those with bodies larger than its own, and that becomes the reason for its low survival rate. It attacks with bubbles heated by the constant high temperatures within its body.

skills.name: Nekki wo Obita Awa
skills.description: Spits bubbles heated by its high body temperature.

digimons.name: Keemon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA bad looking Slime digimon that is always scowling. Even though it is very young, it hates being in crowds, and lives while hiding itself. From a hidden place, it likes to try to harass others, spitting out a paint filled water gun (Pushū).

cites.text: Digimon Tamers Koushiki Daizukan Vol. VI

skills.name: Pushū
skills.description: Spits out a paint-mixed water gun.

digimons.name: Kekomon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Slime Digimon with a richly colored body surface. Although it has a soft and flexible body surface, its three horns are unusually hard for a Slime-type and are useful for defending itself when attacked by intruders. When it senses danger, it spews "Nenchakusei no Awa" from its mouth to distract the opponent, and then seizes the opportunity to flee.

skills.name: Nenchakusei no Awa
skills.description: Spews adhesive bubbles from its mouth.

digimons.name: Ketomon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Slime Digimon whose large eyes are its defining characteristic. These eyes have the ability to discern the nature of Digimon, allowing it to detect violent Digimon in advance and warn its allies of the danger. When cornered, it discharges acidic bubbles from its eyes (Poppin' Tear), rattling the enemy as it cries.

skills.name: Poppin' Tear
skills.description: Discharges acidic bubbles from its eyes.

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Spits slightly acidic bubbles from its eyes.

skills.name: [N 1]
skills.description: Discharges electricity from its horn.

digimons.name: Kuramon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalAn Unidentified Digimon that suddenly appeared on the Computer Network. The aggression generated by the malice of people who abuse the Computer Network, and the conflicts which are unfolding on the Network, manifested and a single Digitama was created. Humanity's destruction instinct is condensed within that Digitama, and as such the mysterious Digimon that was born from it is a very dangerous being. It multiplies like a virus within the Computer Network, causing a slight degree of network failure. Its Special Move is producing a frothy substance from its gigantic eye (Glare Eye).

cites.text: Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth Hacker's Memory
Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth Hacker's Memory
Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth Hacker's Memory

skills.name: Glare Eye
skills.description: 12Produces froth from its eye. Fires a ball of light from its eye.

skills.name: Blood Eye
skills.description: Confuses the enemy.

skills.name: Awa
skills.description: Spits out bubbles from its eye.

digimons.name: Leafmon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Slime Digimon which has a breath of fresh greens (a tiny leaf) on its tail. It has many of the elements of a plant and the composition of its body includes chlorophyll, so it photosynthesizes to grow. It possesses a leaf-shaped tail, and the leaf protects it from intense sunlight or when it is raining. Due to its pure nature, it doesn't distrust others even if they are frightening. However, it is just a little bit shy. As it was just born it is unable to battle, but its innocent spirit, overflowing with vitality, can make the surrounding people remember pure feelings that were forgotten, wrapping them in a calm air. However, if one tries to mess with it too much, it will spit acidic bubbles to intimidate them.

skills.name: Sansei no Awa
skills.description: Spits acidic bubbles from its mouth.

digimons.name: Mokumon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Digimon Baby which envelops its whole body with a smoke-like vapor. It is a unique Digimon whose computer kernel (Digicore), said to be at the center of a Digimon's body, is bare, so it seems it protects its Digicore with Smoke. Because its Digicore is bare, Mokumon is a Digimon of an unusual way of life which covers its body in Smoke from when it was burned. It scatters the Smoke issuing from its body all around, then seizes the opportunity to flee.

skills.name: Smoke
skills.description: Spreads smoke from its body to distract its foes and escape.

skills.name: Kemuri
skills.description: Spreads smoke from its body to distract its foes and escape.

digimons.name: Nyokimon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Seed Digimon whose body surface is covered in transparent tissue. Its real body can be confirmed to be within the transparent skin, and seems to be a variant of Botamon. It is thought that it is perhaps a species of Botamon whose appearance transformed into this herbaceous body. For that reason, it is not only a Plant-species Digimon, but it also has the potential to evolve to Dragon-species Digimon and the like. Its personality is extremely gentle, so it has a timid face. Its offensive ability is nonexistent, so it flings the popping seeds of its "Seed Cracker", then while the opponent is surprised, it quickly flees.

skills.name: Seed Cracker
skills.description: Tries to spit out seeds in order to surprise the enemy long enough for it to escape.

digimons.name: Pafumon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Spirit Digimon that possesses a translucent body. Since its body is light as down, it is constantly drifting through the air. It has the habit of moving upon the winds, and it is said that if the wind's condition is suitable it will migrate a considerable distance. Although it dislikes fights and has a gentle personality, when it gets in a pinch it surprises the opponent by opening its mouth wide, sucking in air, and swelling its body up to three times its usual size (Puff Balloon), then seizes the opportunity to expel the air and escape.

skills.name: Puff Balloon
skills.description: Opens its mouth wide, sucking in air, and swells its body up to three times its usual size then seizes the opportunity to expel the air and escape.

digimons.name: Paomon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalPaomon, unlike other Digimon that developed naturally, is an artificial Digimon that was created through human effort for the purposes of appreciation and rearing. Although there is no shortage of Digimon at the Child stage whose configuration program is remodeled through human effort, Digimon artificially created from the Baby stage are rare. According to one theory, it was developed jointly by research groups in Shanghai, Taiwan, and Okinawa, but its birthplace is not certain. It will sometimes spit highly acidic bubbles to intimidate the opponent.

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Shoots bubble-like substances from its mouth.

digimons.name: Peti Meramon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Digimon that evolved from Mokumon, its entire body is ablaze due to how fiercely its Digicore burns for a body of its size. It has a wild temperament for its small size, causing its Digicore to burn intensely, but it cannot fight properly despite its aggressive personality as its offensive power is still low. Not only that, it is extremely weak to water and Ice-Snow type Digimon, so it will flee the moment it encounters them. Incidentally, any relation between it and Meramon has not yet been made clear. It spits "Chīsana Kaendan" out from its mouth to attack the opponent, but they aren't very powerful.

skills.name: Chīsana Kaendan
skills.description: Spits small flame shots out from its mouth to attack the opponent.

skills.name: Fireball
skills.description: Spits out a ball of flame.

skills.name: Kaendan
skills.description: Fires a small flame shot from its mouth.

digimons.name: Petitmon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Slime Digimon that possesses large horns and tiny wings. As its body is extremely light, it lives constantly floating through the air, and maintains its posture in the air by blowing air from its wings and mouth. Although it usually has a cheerful personality, if the three scales on its belly are touched, it goes into an extremely bad mood. When bodily harm draws near, it spits its "Atsui Toiki" to surprise the opponent, while simultaneously using it as propulsive force to quickly flee, so it's not easy to catch.

skills.name: Atsui Toiki
skills.description: Shoots a small fireball from its mouth towards the adversary.

digimons.name: Pipimon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Baby Digimon that was born from the fruit of a tree. It is said to appear as a Partner before people who have lost and then regained their hope.

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Shoots bubble-like substances from its mouth.

digimons.name: Pitchmon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA microbe-like Digimon which was discovered in the "Net Ocean", which had long been studied as the birthplace of life within the Digital World, it has the smallest size among the many Digimon. Since it seems to be living with nothing but emotions, its behavior changes very frequently. Since it is extremely full of curiosity, it greatly wishes to communicate with the outside world, but as yet, no means to do so has been found. However, it is a Digimon Baby that is loved by everyone, due to its big, bright red eyes which are charming enough to shake the opponent's feelings. It spits out soap-like bubbles from its mouth and blinds the opponent's eyes, then flees.

skills.name: Shabon no Awa
skills.description: Shoots a bubble-like substances from its mouth.

digimons.name: Popomon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Slime Digimon that looks like a species of plant. It skillfully uses its tail, which looks like a leaf, and it moves by jumping little by little. Because it has a very timid personality, it will immediately flee if any strangers approach, but it is said that once it gives its trust to someone, it will be attached to them for life. While escaping the opponent it uses its "Hair Mist", scattering the hairs of its coat to create a distraction.

skills.name: Hair Mist
skills.description: Scatters its hair to make a chance to escape.

digimons.name: Poyomon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalWith a translucent body, it is a Digimon Baby that drifts through the "Net Ocean" like a jellyfish. As it has the most primitive structure among the Digimon discovered to date, it has been showered in attention as the "Missing Link", the key to solving the mystery of the origin of Digimon, by the scholars and enthusiasts studying the roots of Digimon. In order to defend itself from intruders it spews potently acidic bubbles out of its mouth.

cites.text: Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth Hacker's Memory
Digimon Adventure: "Etemon! The Stage Mounting of Evil"
Digimon Adventure:: "The Messenger of Darkness, Devimon"
Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth Hacker's Memory

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Shoots potently acidic bubbles from its mouth.

skills.name: Awa
skills.description: Shoots bubble-like substances from its mouth.

digimons.name: Punimon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA new kind of newborn Digimon. Its gelatinous red body is squishy, and there are three feeler-like things growing on its head. It is unable to battle, but it can produce resilient, acidic bubbles to intimidate its opponents.

cites.text: Digimon Adventure: "The Clashing Ultimates! War Greymon VS Metal Garurumon"

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Produces resilient, acidic bubbles to intimidate its opponents.

skills.name: Awa
skills.description: Spits out bubbles from its mouth.

digimons.name: Pupumon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Slime Digimon which has grown a body as light as a bubble, as well as very thin wings. Its somewhat largish eyes are very sensitive to an object's movement, and if something moves it notices it and immediately springs away, but this does not mean it's a coward, as if it continues to be unkind Pupumon counterattacks. If the opponent approaches, it spits "Doku no Awa" from its mouth to attack.

skills.name: Doku no Awa
skills.description: Spits poisonous bubbles from its mouth.

digimons.name: Pururumon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Slime Digimon with a chubby body similar to silicone, it jiggles flabbily when it crawls forward. Both of its small fins are unexpectedly handy, but to be absolutely precise it is not yet able to fly. As it loves the smell of the sun, on days with good weather it lies sprawled on the lawn and smells the scent of grass with a sniff, immersing it in a good mood. If it gets in a pinch, it foams out acidic bubbles and covers the opponent in them, then seizes the opportunity to flee.

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Shoots bubble-like substances from its mouth.

digimons.name: Pusumon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Slime Digimon whose entire body is covered in soft, cotton-like fur; only the yellow hairs sticking out of its forehead are fairly hard. It grows restless without its pacifier, and will cry loudly and incessantly if its pacifier is lost. It is able to expand its body by taking in a deep breath and shoot that inhaled air out together with its pacifier in order to intimidate the opponent.

skills.name: Oshaburi
skills.description: Takes in a deep breath and shoots the inhaled air out together with its pacifier in order to intimidate the opponent.

digimons.name: Puttimon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalIt is a sacred Digimon Baby who is the template for all Angel-type Digimon. On the other hand, it has poor self-judgment between good and evil, and can be quite adorably mischievous. If anything, it's popular for bringing about euphoria, good fortune, and such. Though as a newborn it's rare for it to do so, it can fly skillfully about the sky with the two wings growing from its back. When it flies about in the sky, it is able to place its opponent in a happy mood with a mysterious powder called "Angel Dust".

skills.name: Angel Dust
skills.description: Sprinkles a mysterious powder over its opponent that puts them in a happy mood.

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Shoots slightly acidic bubbles from its mouth.

digimons.name: Puwamon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Chick Digimon covered in soft feathers. Its eyesight is extremely great, and because it is able to survey a vast range, it can react instantly to surrounding movements. Its personality is intensely curious, and it began gaining popularity because it lacks shyness and easily makes attachments. However, it extremely dislikes when its tail is touched, and so if its tail is touched carelessly, caution will be necessary, since it will shower you down in blinding feathers (Fuwā Feather).

skills.name: Fuwā Feather
skills.description: Shocks whoever touches the Fuwa Feather on its tail.

digimons.name: Puyomon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA soft and sticky Slime Digimon that was discovered in the "Net Ocean". Its single, lens-like eye lacks emotional expression, so you can't tell what it's thinking, but it drifts through the sky or the sea, trying to stick to objects and other Digimon with its tentacles. Once it sticks onto something, it will emit tingling static electricity (Pachipachi Gas), but this seems to be a form of communication unique to Puyomon rather than an attack. When multiple Puyomon stick to each other, their "Pachipachi Gas" becomes more powerful, making it difficult to approach the surrounding area.

skills.name: Pachipachi Gas
skills.description: Emits a tingling static electricity.

skills.name: Earnta
skills.description: Slaps the opponent with its large ear.

digimons.name: Relemon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA mysterious Digimon that is said to only be born on moonlit nights. It is said that Relemon born specifically on the night of the full moon receive its magical power, and as they grow, are able to use greater and more wondrous abilities than other Digimon. Because it is nocturnal, it seldom appears before people and has a shy personality. It is not able to attack, but it can transform into anything to defend itself, if it is close to the size of its body. However, it can still be found because it can never conceal its tail.

cites.text: Digimon Tamers Koushiki Daizukan Vol. VI

skills.name: Henshin
skills.description: Transforms into things close to its body size.

skills.name: Entwine
skills.description: Constricts the opponent with its tentacles.

digimons.name: Sakumon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA tiny Digimon with a single blade protruding from its head. Its whole body is golden, and the blade on its head shines very brightly. Its personality is mischievous and it is constantly moving as long as it is awake, but it is bad at balancing due to the weight of its head, so surrounding Digimon can occasionally be seen running around trying to escape because of it swinging its blade as it rolls around.

digimons.name: Sunamon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Slime Digimon whose body is made of sand. Despite being a Baby, it has an aggressive personality and is very territorial. It has a body that falls apart like sand, or conversely, hardens like clay at will, but its pacifier never changes shape. If approached by an enemy, it threatens them by throwing a large amount of sand.

skills.name: Sunakake
skills.description: Threatens enemies that approach by throwing a large amount of sand.

skills.name: Hinotama
skills.description: Blinds the opponent by making the gas surrounding its body glow intensely.

digimons.name: Torikara Ballmon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Digimon born from deep-fried food recipe data. Because it flies while giving off a delicious, lingering aroma, it seems that if Torikara Ballmon is nearby, other Digimon around it will feel more hungry. When chased by hungry Digimon, it blows "Shokubutsusei no Awa" from its mouth to make them slippery and files away, leaving only its scent behind while hindering their movements.

skills.name: Shokubutsusei no Awa
skills.description: Blows bubbles from its mouth to make the opponent slippery and hinder their movements.

digimons.name: Tsubumon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Baby Digimon which has an appearance like a seed, although it is not a Plant-species Digimon. It cannot fly, but it is able to move over land, water, or anywhere, while hopping and bouncing, and it is said that there is no place where Tsubumon cannot move through. However, because of its small body it is sent flying on days with a strong wind, and as a result of that it is often mistaken for a Plant-species. With its Signature Move "San no Awa", it drives off the opponent.

skills.name: Awa
skills.description: Produces bubbles from its body.

digimons.name: Yukimi Botamon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Baby Digimon whose whole body is covered in fluffy, white hair. It is considered a species of Botamon, and was named "Yukimi Botamon" after its white body, but the details are not clearly known. It is weak to heat, and tends to prefer cold places, so its body feels cold to the touch. Its attack technique is breathing out freezing cold air (Diamond Dust). When Yukimi Botamon exhales, the moisture in the air freezes, and falls while brilliantly glittering.

skills.name: Diamond Dust
skills.description: Breathes out freezing cold air.

digimons.name: Yuramon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Seed Digimon whose whole body is covered in a substance with the appearance of long, soft hair. When it hatches from its Digitama, it seeks an environment suitable for its growth, and drifts lightly through the air, like a dandelion seed. If it finds a place where there will be no intruders and where the environment is good, it will settle to the ground and begin preparations for evolution. Its offensive ability is practically nil, so it will spit out adhesive bubbles to hinder the opponent's movement, then seize the opportunity to escape.

skills.name: Nenchakusei no Awa
skills.description: Releases sticky bubbles to restrict its opponent's movement.

digimons.name: Zerimon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalAn extremely rare Digimon, which is born in pairs from a single Digitama. The reason why only Zerimon and Cocomon are born as twins is unclear at the present stage. Moreover, they are not restricted to always being born as twins, and either a Zerimon or Cocomon may be born from a single Digitama. Compared to the extremely energetic, one-horned Zerimon, the three-horned Cocomon has a relatively docile personality. In addition, unlike other Slime Digimon, more of Zerimon than just the horn on its head is firm-knit and rigid. Like other Baby Digimon, it spits acid bubbles to intimidate opponents.

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Spits acidic bubbles to intimidate enemies.

digimons.name: Zurumon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalAs a Digimon that was born from fusing a malevolent computer virus and the negativity of humans who abuse computers, it is a special Slime Digimon which differs from other Digimon in its root cause. It nimbly maneuvers its pliable body, and moves as if crawling across the ground. Because the substance composing its body is a potent toxin, and it spews intensely venomous bubbles from its mouth, even large Digimon will not approach it.

skills.name: Doku no Awa
skills.description: Spits out severely toxic bubbles.

digimons.name: Algomon (Baby II)
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalThe form that a newborn Algomon grows into. It clings to places where high-capacity data leaks, and consumes that data through the mouth on its underside. When an enemy draws near, it spits out "San no Awa" from its giant eye-like pattern.

evolvesFrom.name: Algomon (Baby I)
evolvesFrom.note: Baby I

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Shoots bubble-like substances from its giant eye-like pattern.

cites.text: Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth Hacker's Memory
Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth Hacker's Memory

skills.name: Data Drain
skills.description: Stabs the sharp portions of its limbs into the opponent and completely absorbs their data.

digimons.name: Babydmon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Baby Dragon Digimon whose body bears a striking resemblance to a dragon. While this Digimon was only discovered recently, it has been made clear through data analysis that it contains a program code specific to ancient Digimon, and that it is related to the long-lost, ancient species of Digimon. Babydmon is ferocious despite its small size, and anyone who makes careless movements in front of it will get blown at with the high temperature gas formed within its body (Hot Gas). Aside from the heat, Hot Gas is also made up of pungent elements, so it is recommended that one washes their eyes with water promptly should any gas enter their eyes.

skills.name: Hot Gas
skills.description: Generates heat from deep within its body, puffing it out towards the enemy as a pungent gas.

skills.name: Minimal Flash
skills.description: A static electricity-laced tackle.

skills.name: Mikkomi
skills.description: Slaps the opponent with its ears.

skills.name: Puppy Spark
skills.description: Intimidates the opponent with a spark-filled bark.

digimons.name: Budmon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalBlended from the data of various poisonous plants, it is a Plant Digimon which has the form of a flower bud. Usually, it drifts through the air carried by its leaf, and doesn't attack as long as nothing happens. Its Special Move is its "Dokutogetoge", which are painful if touched. If it gets angry, it can also fire off the thorns.

skills.name: Dokutogetoge
skills.description: Fires off poisonous thorns.

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Shoots slightly acidic bubbles from its mouth.

digimons.name: Caprimon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA tiny Baby Digimon wearing a metallic helmet. Within the two horns attached to its helmet, it has antennae that are able to receive any radio wave or sound. Caprimon has bat-like traits such as having weak eyesight, instead producing ultrasonic waves from its mouth to detect objects ahead of it based on the rebounding sound waves. For that reason, Caprimon is able to remain active regardless of whether it is day or night. Its technique is generating a resonance between its two horns (Howling Hertz); even a large Digimon will have their sense of hearing paralyzed if they suffer this technique.

skills.name: Howling Hertz
skills.description: Generates a resonance between its two horns to paralyze the opponent.

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Shoots slightly acidic bubbles from its mouth.

digimons.name: Chapmon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Lesser Digimon that only lives in clear, beautiful waters. For this reason, it is only seen in a limited number of areas within the Digital World. It spends most of the day on the water's surface, and when it sleeps, it sleeps with only its face poking out of the water. It has the sensitivity to detect the approach of opponents just from tiny movements of the water's surface, and will escape to a safe spot before it is found. Even when it is found, it spits its "Foam Shower" from its mouth to confuse the opponent with the bubbles, then flees.

skills.name: Foam Shower
skills.description: Spits bubbles from its mouth to confuse an attacker.

digimons.name: Chibimon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Baby Dragon Digimon that evolved from Chicomon. It has a torso, hands, and feet—unusual for a Baby Digimon—and so is able to grip objects with both of its small hands, and move while hopping about with both feet. It has a voracious appetite and especially likes sweet foods. Also, as it is very fond of sleeping, it will fall asleep the moment you take your eyes off of it. Its Special Move is ramming into the opponent while hopping about (Hop Attack).

skills.name: Hop Attack
skills.description: Rams into the opponent while hopping about.

digimons.name: Chicchimon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA Chick Digimon whose whole body is covered in soft, yellow down. Since it cannot fly yet, it moves around by jumping while desperately flapping its tiny wings. It is frequently seen diligently using its tiny beak to groom the long feathers growing from its head, which seems to be an important aspect of it that can be considered its trademark.



Its "Piyopiyo", which it emits when it senses that it is in danger, is an ultrasonic cry that could knock out even Childs if heard at close range. It quickly flees to protect itself while those who have heard its cry are incapacitated.

cites.text: Digimon Story: Lost Evolution (V Jump scan)

skills.name: Piyopiyo
skills.description: Emits an ultrasonic cry.

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Shoots slightly acidic bubbles from its mouth.

skills.name: Petit Holy Flare
skills.description: Gathers light energy which explodes.

digimons.name: Chocomon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Digimon that grew up from Cocomon. Although the personalities of the lively Gummymon and the docile Chocomon are opposites, they get along very well and always act in unison. The two are effectively of one mind and body, so much so that should one be separated from the other, it would weaken from loneliness. Its Special Move is spewing out a lot of adhesive bubbles (Double Bobble).

cites.text: Digimon Tamers Koushiki Daizukan Vol. VI

skills.name: Double Bobble
skills.description: Fires a stream of adhesive bubbles from its mouth.

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Shoots slightly acidic bubbles from its mouth.

digimons.name: Culumon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA small Digimon shrouded in mystery that is unable to evolve or attack, unlike other Digimon. As it is friendly and loves to play, it will appear out of nowhere as long as there is fun to be had. It has a habit of adding "Culu" to the end of its sentences. Rumor has it that it possesses the ability to help other Digimon evolve.

skills.name: Culumon no Inori
skills.description: Heals an ally.

skills.name: Keter Flare
skills.description: Attacks with light.

skills.name: Shining Evolution
skills.description: Releases the full power of the Digi-Entelechy, causing any Digimon touched by its light to evolve.

digimons.name: Cupimon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Small Angel Digimon that evolved from Puttimon. It likes benevolence and loves making everyone happy, contrary to when it was a Puttimon. In particular, it is referred to as the "Angel of Charity", and it specializes in bringing about feelings of "Love" in every person. It is always flying around the Digital World's skies, sprinkling love on everyone while making them feel happy. It is said that even a large Digimon with great fighting spirit will cease battling once it encounters Cupimon. Its Special Move is generating a ring of light from the protuberance on its calvaria and throwing it at the opponent (Angel Ring).

skills.name: Angel Ring
skills.description: Generates a ring of light from the protuberance on its calvaria and throws it at the opponent.

digimons.name: Dorimon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Lesser Digimon that can run very quickly, as long as it is going straight. Dorimon often remain wild as they hate to be domesticated, and approaching one is risky as it will recklessly charge and perform a ramming attack. Its ears have grown sharp and hard, doubling as horns and inflicting a little damage on whatever it rams into, though it can't turn when going at speed. Its Special Move is spewing an iron bead out of its mouth while charging at the opponent (Metal Drop).

skills.name: Metal Drop
skills.description: Spits iron grains from mouth while charging at the enemy.

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Shoots slightly acidic bubbles from its mouth.

digimons.name: Flamon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Digimon that was transformed into a half-beast, half-man form when Agnimon lost its power. It is missing the "Combat Instinct" that Digimon naturally possess, and moreover, it has lost power. However, it is a being that has inherited a Spirit of the legendary Ten Warriors who possess ultimate strength, so although it has lost power, ordinary Adult-class Digimon aren't a match for it. If anything, it has kindness inappropriate for a Digimon and is similar to a Child Digimon, counterbalancing its mischievous part. Its Special Move is firing off an aura of flames (Baby Salamander).

cites.text: Digimon Frontier: "My Home! Takuya's Lonely Return"

skills.name: Baby Salamander
skills.description: 12Fires off an aura of flames. Flips through the air covered in fire.

skills.name: Noble Heart
skills.description: A flaming uppercut.

skills.name: Flame Toss
skills.description: Tosses a small fireball.

skills.name: Birdy Head
skills.description: A headbutt that capitalizes on its speed.

digimons.name: Frimon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Lesser Digimon possessing a frill on its neck. Its frill was made from a hardened portion of its hairs, and by covering its body with the frill when danger approaches, it can be used as "Armor" to protect its body. Since it is extremely full of curiosity, it has a habit of responding to anything that moves, but because it also responds to its own tail, it chases after it, and is often observed spinning in place. Increasing the centrifugal force in its long tail (Shippo Binta) is a power in itself, and it occasionally seems that even a Child Digimon will instantly faint if it is hit cleanly.

skills.name: Shippo Binta
skills.description: Uses the centrifugal force in its tail to attack the enemy.

digimons.name: Gaossmon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA tiny Digimon strong only in competitive spirit, and in any case it barks a lot.



It is also quick to flee, and extremely swift. Although it is almost impossible to track it down after it runs into the bushes, it will soon begin to bark, giving away its location. Since it specializes in running on land, it dreads water and is totally incapable of swimming. In fact, it can't even cross a 10 cm deep brook, and Gaossmon have occasionally been found nearly drowned and passed out in a puddle of water.



Its Special Moves are a medium-temperature jet of flames (Kilo Flame), and an intense headbutt (Head Strike).

cites.text: Digital Monster COLOR Digimon Xros Wars 15th Edition

skills.name: Kilo Flame
skills.description: A medium-temperature jet of flames.

skills.name: Head Strike
skills.description: An intense headbutt.

digimons.name: Gigimon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA four-legged Baby Digimon that grew from Jyarimon. Its physical features resemble those of Tokomon, and powerful fangs also line the interior of its mouth. However, unlike Tokomon, who evolves into the Mammal-species, Gigimon, who evolves into the Dragon-species, has a rough personality and is ferocious despite its small size. There are more than a few even larger Digimon who were deceived by its appearance and suffered a counterattack. Its Special Move is snapping at the opponent (Hot Bite). Its body temperature is hot, just like Jyarimon, and it is said that it leaves burns on the areas it bites.

cites.text: Digimon Tamers: "Dreaming Power is Our Future"

skills.name: Hot Bite
skills.description: Attacks with a burning bite.

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Shoots slightly acidic bubbles from its mouth.

skills.name: Rock Breath
skills.description: Spits out rocks from its large mouth.

digimons.name: Gummymon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Digimon that grew up from Zerimon. As it inherited an exceedingly energetic personality from Zerimon, it is both cheerful and lively. Although it is growing, it's squishy because its body tissue is as unstable as usual, but just like Zerimon, parts of its horn have hardened and it intimidates the opponent with headbutts. Its greatest change from Zerimon is that it has a body and ear-like objects coming out of its head. Its Special Move is spewing out a lot of adhesive bubbles (Double Bobble).

cites.text: Digimon Adventure 02: Vol. 1: Digimon Hurricane Landing!!/Vol. 2: Transcendent Evolution!! The Golden Digimentals

skills.name: Double Bobble
skills.description: Spits out a lot of adhesive bubbles.

skills.name: Double Bubble
skills.description: Spits out a lot of adhesive bubbles.

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Shoots slightly acidic bubbles from its mouth.

skills.name: Chikuchiku Attack
skills.description: Charges with its horns.

digimons.name: Hiyarimon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA Lesser Digimon that evolved from Yukimi Botamon. The fluffy cilia it once had are now gone, and instead the surface of its body is always covered with snow. It lives mostly in snowy mountains, and its body melts when exposed to sunlight, so it is active after sunset. It seems that the bigger the icicle is that hangs from the tip of its beak, the more energized it is.



Its Signature Move is spewing cold breath (Diamond Dust).

skills.name: Diamond Dust
skills.description: Spews cold breath.

digimons.name: Hopmon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Baby Dragon Digimon that evolved from Ketomon. Its entire body is covered in scales small enough to be invisible to the naked eye, and its body is sturdier than it looks. It has overcome its timid personality, and has a budding sense of justice that despises the crooked even at its young age. Its Signature Move is bouncing like a Super Ball and striking with its rear (Hop Hip).

skills.name: Hop Hip
skills.description: Bounces like a Super Ball and strikes with its rear.

skills.name: Kankan
skills.description: Strikes at the opponent with the sharp corners of its shield.

skills.name: Beat Lick
skills.description: Strikes using its tongue.

digimons.name: Koromon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA tiny Digimon that shed the fuzz covering its surface, and whose body grew even bigger. Although it has become able to move around more actively, it is still unable to battle. It can produce bubbles from its mouth to intimidate opponents.

Digimon Adventure: "Adrift? The Island of Adventure"

skills.description: Produces bubbles from its mouth to intimidate opponents.

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Spits out slightly acidic bubbles from its mouth.

skills.name: Poyoyon Tackle
skills.description: Softly tackles its opponent with its whole body.

digimons.name: Kozenimon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA small Digimon in the shape of a 1-yen coin that resides within Ganemon's trunk. It is always full of cheer, and its strength is its ability to stay optimistic even during periods of recession. It cheerfully carries out its task of collecting money as ordered to by Ganemon, toiling by its motto "Even 1 yen, when accumulated, can become 1 million yen". Kozenimon often act in groups, which is reflected in its Special Moves such as "Icchi Dan Ketsu", where they attack simultaneously in great numbers, and "¥UE-N", where all of the Kozenimon who have been made fun of by an enemy come and cry together, creating a shockwave.
A winning entry in the Digimon Xros Wars Original Digimon Contest.

skills.name: Icchi Dan Ketsu
skills.description: All Kozenimon attack the enemy together.

skills.name: ¥UE-N
skills.description: All Kozenimon create a shock wave by crying out.

digimons.name: Kyaromon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Lesser Digimon that vigorously grew a tail. As it is brimming with curiosity, it takes an interest in anything, and has a habit of rushing for whatever caught its interest. The inside of its body has become mostly empty, and because it is elastic like a rubber ball, its "Shippo Swing", in which it puts its strength into its tail and strikes, seems to have the force to blow away even a Child Digimon.

skills.name: Shippo Swing
skills.description: Puts all its strength into striking the opponent with its tail.

digimons.name: Kyokyomon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Lesser Digimon whose body has grown long. If it gets angry it can stretch up to nearly nine times its normal length to attack the opponent, but because it only extends forward, the opponent usually avoids it completely. It has a light body like Fufumon, and floats lightly through the air, but it is able to move relatively nimbly by paddling the air with its hands and feet. Its Special Move is stretching itself out and then firing an iron spike from its mouth (Metal Straw).

skills.name: Metal Straw
skills.description: Stretches itself out and fires a metal spike from its mouth.

cites.text: "ナゾのデジモン(成長期)". しゃべってキャラ ミュージアム. Date unknown.

digimons.name: Minomon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Digimon that is an evolution of Leafmon, and went into a tough outer shell. On days with good weather, or when it's in a good mood, it sticks its face out of its shell and vegetates. It hangs onto high places with the ivy (hair?) growing from its head, and moves by hanging onto large Digimon, but if it's over a short distance, it is also able to move by floating through the air. Due to its vegetative personality, it has a fault of not easily showing its emotions on its face. Also, as solitude is its "specialty", it has the inner fortitude to not be discouraged even if it gets worried and anxious. Its Special Move is throwing a hard, pine cone-shaped substance (Pinecone).

skills.name: Pinecone
skills.description: Throws a hard, pinecone-shaped object at the enemy.

skills.name: Worm Barrier
skills.description: Reduces damage taken from normal attacks.

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Shoots slightly acidic bubbles from its mouth.

digimons.name: Missimon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Machine Digimon with a missile for a body. The moment it evolves into Missimon, its missile is ignited and sends it flying non-stop until it further evolves into another Digimon. While it is able to adjust its flight speed to some extent, it is unable to stop moving as it will fall if it does not maintain a sufficient flight speed. It can utilize this speed to do a body tackle (Missile Crash), sporting great destructive power, but this attack almost never hits its target due to Missimon's sub-par control.

skills.name: Missile Crash
skills.description: Using its speed, it rams powerfully into the enemy.

digimons.name: Mochimon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalPossessing elastic skin, this soft-bodied Digimon uses the protuberances on the underside of its body to toddle about. It came to be called "Mochimon" from how it inflates its body when it gets worked up, causing it to look like mochi. However, it possesses great intellect unimaginable from its appearance, leading to speculation that it originated from a computer's dictionary feature. It understands human languages, and is sometimes seen freely deforming its body as if attempting communication. It produces mochi-like elastic bubbles to restrict the opponent's movement.

skills.name: Nen'un
skills.description: Spews out sticky cumulus clouds to slow down the opponent.

digimons.name: Monimon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA low-ranking ninja Digimon that always operates in a group. Even though they are said to be in a group, they each operate within a fixed range from the others while hidden under vegetation or in the shade of a rock, and it can be said that while it has the appearance of an underling, it seems to be a ninja after all. Its emotions tend to project on its face, so while it always pretends to be calm, its emotions show up on its face (monitor) in the shape of emoticons. Furthermore, because it even projects its dreams from its face when it is asleep, everyone can see them, and it gets very embarrassed. Its Special Moves are leaping upon the opponent in a group (Rappa), firing a water pistol from its mouth (Suppa), and instantly running away at high speed (Toppa).

skills.name: Rappa
skills.description: Gangs up on the opponent with other Monimon.

skills.name: Suppa
skills.description: Sprays a water pistol from its mouth.

skills.name: Toppa
skills.description: Instantly runs away at high speed or teleports itself and allies out of harm's way.

digimons.name: Moonmon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Baby Digimon with an appearance resembling a falling droplet. Only appearing on bright moonlit nights, there are records of it being sighted near Pokomon, which has a similar habit. A characteristic antenna-like protuberance grows from its head, and swings energetically whenever it is in a good mood. Its Special Move is spewing cold bubbles that glow a bluish-white (Moonlight Bubble).

skills.name: Moonlight Bubble
skills.description: Spews cold bubbles that glow a bluish-white

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Shoots slightly acidic bubbles from its mouth.

skills.name: Yami Burst
skills.description: Fires a ball of dark energy.

digimons.name: Negamon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Baby Digimon that grew up immersed in the negative data that the Network is overflowing with. It lives quietly in jet-black darkness, constantly awaiting its death. It appears before approaching Digimon, and makes them prey on themselves with the curse of its "Downer Eye". It is said that the Digimon that have preyed on themselves gradually lose their emotions, fall into darkness, and corrode from the inside out, becoming a seedbed for Negamon to regenerate.

skills.name: Downer Eye
skills.description: Curses enemy Digimon to prey on themselves.

skills.name: Negative Pain
skills.description: Casts a curse on an enemy by visualizing the surrounding negative energy.

digimons.name: Nyaromon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA tiny Digimon with cat-like characteristics. It is always capricious, and it seems it was given the name Nyaromon due to how 'cat'-like its behaviour is. Although it is overflowing with curiosity and can be quite fickle, it also has a lonely side. Its Special Move is puffing up its tail, making the hairs like wires and then striking the opponent (Fox Tail). However, there has never yet been an opponent observed to flinch from this attack.

digimons.name: Otamamon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA larva Digimon whose skin has not yet fully hardened because of its choice to live underwater. It swims in lakes and rivers upstream of the Net Ocean with its large tail, and occasionally climbs onto rocks with its developed forelimbs and does vocal training. Its mostly undeveloped hindlimbs act as rudders in place of its tail, which has gained propulsive power, contrary to typical organisms. It is valuable among Child levels in that it signals its upcoming evolution clearly, but since its potential for mutation is extremely high, caution is necessary when raising it. Its Special Move is sending the opponent into an eternal slumber (Lullaby Bubble).

skills.name: Tai Atari
skills.description: Tackles the enemy headfirst.

digimons.name: Pagumon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA small-sized Digimon capable of flying at low altitudes using the ear-like parts growing from its head. It is able to move those ears skillfully and use them like hands, performing gestures such as pulling its eyelid and sticking its tongue out, or slapping its rear to mock the opponent. It has a prank-loving personality. It will bully Digimon such as Koromon or Tunomon by chasing them around. Sometimes, it also bullies others by spitting out "Doku no Awa" from its mouth.

cites.text: Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth Hacker's Memory

skills.name: San no Awa
skills.description: Shoots slightly acidic bubbles from its mouth.

skills.name: Tackle
skills.description: Tackles the opponent with all its might.

digimons.name: Pickmon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalDigimon which are enrolled in the "Starmons" corps, where they make up most of the members. The "Starmons" are composed of a corps of several Pickmon with a Starmon at their heart. There is a strict hierarchy to the corps, and disobedience is not allowed because they must have absolute obedience to their superior. For that reason, there are more than a few Pickmon who have given up midway on becoming a Starmon, then left and gone back home, but nevertheless, Pickmon that work hard, aim at independence, and stand out from the crowd will succeed in being promoted to Major and becoming a Starmon.

Digital Monster COLOR Digimon Xros Wars 15th Edition
Digital Monster COLOR Digimon Xros Wars 15th Edition

digimons.name: Pinamon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Chick Digimon that always runs about restlessly. Because it expresses its emotions in how it runs, it doesn't stand still unless it is a time when it is bored or sleeping. Because its emotions do not appear on its face, its emotions must be read from how it runs, so it is a Digimon with which making a connection is very difficult. Although Pinamon hates its tails being touched, just like Puwamon, because a miniature electric shock, "Piripiri Spark", is generated from the tails, more caution is needed when touching its tails than with Puwamon.

evolvesTo.name: Falcomon (2006 Anime Version)
evolvesTo.line: Falcomon (2006 Anime Version) (with or without Burst Evolution)

skills.name: Piripiri Spark
skills.description: Shocks whoever touches the Fuwa Feathers on its tails.

digimons.name: Pokomon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA nocturnal Baby Digimon that evolved from Relemon. Due to it only acting in the evening and on moonlit nights, it is said that its existence is close to an illusion. For that reason, it confers a kind of status among Tamers to raise a Pokomon. It will grow into an extremely heartening Digimon depending on how it was raised. It always acts to avoid public notice, and although it is difficult to capture Pokomon, who is swift and speedy despite its appearance, it will show up without thinking if you set out its favorite food of fried tofu. Its Special Move is changing into a stone that spouts a toxic gas (Sesshou-seki).

cites.text: Digimon Tamers Koushiki Daizukan Vol. VI
Digimon Tamers: "Dreaming Power is Our Future"

skills.name: Sesshouseki
skills.description: Transforms into a stone and releases a poisonous gas.

digimons.name: Poromon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Small Bird Digimon that evolved from Pururumon, and can now fly at low altitudes. It has small feathers growing closely packed on its body, and unusually for a Baby Digimon, it has wings. Its most charming feature is the feather ornament attached to its head, so it maintains it intently. It has a fundamentally tidy personality, but because it cannot turn its neck(?) even if it wants to groom itself, it relies on its comrades. Its Signature Move "Pororo Breeze" is flapping its wings to raise a cloud of sand, then seizing the opportunity to flee when the opponent flinches.

skills.description: Flaps its wings to raise a cloud of sand, then seizes the opportunity to flee when the opponent flinches.

digimons.name: Pukamon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalAlthough its appearance gives the image of an aquatic dinosaur infant, this playful Digimon's clever movements are like those of a seahorse. However, the friendly personality it had as Pitchmon has totally vanished, and it quickly flees if others approach. Its outer skin cannot yet bear the water pressure and low temperature of the deep sea, so the duration it can spend submerged in deep waters is not long.

digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA quadrupedal Lesser Digimon with yellow spines growing from its back. It is always running around energetically, though it will sometimes appear to stop in its tracks when in reality it has just fallen asleep on the spot. Its Signature Move is causing the fur covering its body to stand and harden, then curling itself into a ball and doing a jump-tackle while spinning (Chikuchiku Rolling).

digimons.name: Pyocomon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Bulb-type Lesser Digimon with a large flower blooming from its head. It is able to move by skilfully manoeuvring its root-like tentacles, and it can even float upwards into the air, albeit only to a small height. It is brimming with curiosity, and its restless movements make it look downright adorable. It has a habit of living together in flocks, and they may number from a few to even a few hundred depending on the flock.

digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Bulb Digimon with something resembling plant sprout burgeoning from its head. Due to its extremely timid personality, the moment it senses an intruder's presence, it will burrow into the ground with its four feet and bury its main body beneath the surface. Once it is completely hidden underground, the thing growing from its head camouflages as a plant, allowing it to defend itself from intruders. However, this is ineffective against herbivorous Digimon.

digimons.name: Agnimon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Digimon that possesses power over Flame which bears the might of one of the legendary Warrior Ten. Because its "Digicore" is wrapped in the Spiritual Fire which is called a holy blaze, it is able to freely manipulate flames. It is an incarnation of the "Firewall" that defends the Net, and is also a guardian deity. Because of its easily fired-up personality, it has a soldier-like aspect that practices mental training with yoga exercises, and its way of speaking is somewhat archaic, like a kenpo artist. In battle, it fights by freely using Oriental martial arts, and accumulates flames at one point of its body with a trick that focuses its spirit, to raise its offensive ability. Its Special Moves are unleashing a blazing dragon from its flame-clad fist (Burning Salamander), and unleashing a whirlwind kick of flames (Salamander Break).

digimons.name: Bacomon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA Digimon who hides its entire body within cardboard boxes. Its personality is timid to the point that it prefers to confine itself indoors, but being covered in cardboard bestows it a sense of security that allows it to walk about outdoors uninhibited. Anyone who tries to peek at the insides of the cardboard boxes will end up getting packed into and trapped within one of the boxes. It is not fond of battling as the cardboard covering it is very soft. Its Special Moves are flinging the packing tape it holds in its hand, encircling and wrapping the opponent to stop them in their tracks (Gum Roll), before wrapping the battle up by packing them into a cardboard box and hurling them away (Transdelivery).
A winning entry in the Digimon Xros Wars Original Digimon Contest.

digimons.name: Bakumon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Digimon which has the appearance of the Baku, said to be a dream-eating mythical beast. It is thought that it is a Digimon that was generated from a medical computer for detecting brain waves, and it seems that it uses the data from humans in REM sleep as nourishment. In recent studies, it has been proven that it has the power to purge particularly bad nightmares and malignant computer viruses. Also, since it has the ability to change the captured nightmares and viruses back to normal, it is considered a holy Digimon. There is surely some kind of connection between that sacred, unique ability, and the "Holy Ring" which it wears on its foreleg. Its Special Move is releasing its captured nightmares all at once, drowning the opponent in terror (Nightmare Syndrome). This is the same technique as that of the Perfect Digimon, Digitamamon, but its connection to Bakumon is a mystery.

However, once it begins to battle, with the uncommon physical strength and will-power it possesses—to continue battling no matter what kind of attack it suffers—it becomes a very reliable being. The ability for close combat hidden within its body is very strong, to the point that it bound its fists in leather belts so that its special punches wouldn't hurt itself. Its Special Move is driving a punch into the opponent's chest with all its strength (Koguma Seikendzuki).

However, because its body is made mainly out of ice, its body will shrink and its power will weaken when exposed to high temperatures. Due to being brought up in areas with small populations, they will tend to form very strong bonds even with Digimon of different species that they encounter. It is especially close to Penmon. Its Special Moves are exhaling chilled air from its mouth, shooting out countless shards of ice (Baby Hail), and attacking continuously with its outer shell of ice (Ice Mash).

As it is poor at fighting, it is usually boisterous and lively, but when push comes to shove, it becomes surprisingly reliable, instantly taking on a serious look. Its Special Move is running away at tremendous speed when it feels that it can't win (Nigeashimou Dash).

It aims to start a first-rate hamburger restaurant that will bring in a lot of customers with Ebi Burgamon. It is merciless to those who disturb others while they are eating, and drives them away with its "Delicious Patty", where it places the opponent inside a large, delicious patty and kneads them, and "Green Pickles", in which it throws a pickle-shaped disk at them like a frisbee.

It appears to excel at attacking at varied paces.

When the Digicore on its head ceases to burn, Candmon becomes unable to maintain its life processes. One theory suggests that the flame on its head is its true form, and that the rest of its body is naught but a dummy. Despite being a Flame Digimon, it has a docile personality and will not cause harm to its surroundings out of its own volition. Its Special Move is spitting out small fireballs (Bonfire).

Because it proliferates abnormally when the temperature exceeds 30°C, Chikurimon can often be seen thickly crowded into lakes or around rocks with the coming of summer, and Digimon that come to drink water are often attacked. Its "Final Chikurimon", which sacrifices itself just as the name suggests, is the final Special Move of a Chikurimon that explodes itself together with its opponent.

digimons.name: Chiropmon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Mammal Digimon whose appearance resembles a hood-wearing bat. Possessing remarkable information gathering and analytical capabilities, it is rumored to be a Digimon that was originally born from software used for intelligence gathering, analysis, and parsing by intelligence agencies. It is able to flap its wings almost soundlessly, allowing it to gather and analyze information without its target noticing. However, since Chiropmon bases its actions on things it has an interest in, the information it gathers is often no more valuable than a broad range of trivia. It has the ability to emit ultrasonic waves from its mouth, and uses both its "Paralyze Echo", which is capable of paralyzing the target, and its "Analyze Echo", in which it uses ultrasonic echolocation to grasp what is going on in its surroundings. Chiropmon's eyes have a feature known as "Curious Eyes", which enables it to "see" electromagnetic wavelengths up to ultraviolet and infrared, in addition to visible light, allowing it to obtain information that cannot be seen with the naked eye. Chiropmon has virtually no fighting spirit and is not a Digimon that would attack on its own, but when battle is unavoidable, it will use its attack technique "Condensed Echo", in which it compresses ultrasonic waves to their utmost limit and then emits them from its mouth.

Its personality is just like Toy Agumon's, and despite being cowardly, it possesses a heart of justice that cannot turn a blind eye to evil. Its Special Moves are spitting out a toy flame (Precious Flare), and similarly, launching a toy missile from its mouth (Dream Missile).

⇨ OriginalA mischievous and peppy but timid Fairy Digimon that lives in cold areas.



Although they may look like large rabbit-ears, it has not ears, but a kind of sense organ with which it can sense the approach of other Digimon in no time. Thanks to this, it is extremely rare to catch sight of Cutemon, because it will immediately hide itself. If you do happen to catch sight of one, it is either a rare fortune, or Cutemon is mischievously luring you into a trap. Its trademark muffler is beyond imagination with its insulating properties, as it is very warm. If you are able to obtain one, you can call yourself lucky.



It has the ability to heal wounds, and if it's in the vicinity of an injured Digimon, it will come closer, taking care not to be noticed, and heal that Digimon. Its scratches and cuts are already healed before it realizes what's going on, due to Cutemon's cute and mischievous nature.

digimons.name: Deadly Axemon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA younger brother who exchanged cups of brotherhood with Skull Knightmon, it is a brawny fighter replete with nimble movements and limitless physical strength. It faithfully obeys its sworn brother Skull Knightmon, and battles with faith in its sworn brother in order to obtain victory. It shows off lightning-speed movements fast enough that they earned it the alias "Running Lightning", and its top speed is so fast that it leaves afterimages. However, fine maneuvers are its weak point, so not only are its linear movements easily read by its opponent, it easily collides with obstacles too. However, if you see its sturdy body smashing through obstacles as if they were nothing and continuing to run with a defiant, thunderous roar, you would probably agree that the name "Running Lightning" is appropriate for it. Its Special Moves are running between opponents at the speed of light, who aren't even able to realize before they're cut down (Air Slicer), and spewing a powerful solution that dissolves everything (Aqua Rage). Furthermore, it has an even stronger technique, "Aqua Regia", in which it liquefies itself and swallows up everything in its surroundings.

digimons.name: Dondokomon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA festival-loving Digimon that will appear out of the blue wherever there is a commotion and pound out a heated rhythm, livening the place up. Its unique rhythm, as well as its beats that will shake one's body to the core, stimulate the listener's nerves and gets them completely excited. Although it is sure to get people fired up at competitions, if by some chance Dondokomon shows up at a brawl, it will definitely grow into a battle royal which swallows up even the excited onlookers, causing a catastrophe. Although its sole intention is to provide its support, once it sounds its "Dondoko Ondo", which raises the tension between friend and foe alike, there isn't anything that will settle the commotion. Anyone who interrupts Dondokomon's performances will be punished with its Special Move "Midareuchi Rush", which fires shock waves at random.

digimons.name: DORUmon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Beast Digimon that is, because of the outdated Interface on its brow, presumed to be an experimental "Prototype Digimon" from before Digimon were discovered. The personality of natural Combat Species Digimon manifests particularly strongly within it, so its combat instinct is high; it often barks and bites at everything as a result, though it apparently feels a sense of attachment to something after biting it. The data that is said to have been hidden within the deepest parts of its Digicore during an experiment is the potent life-force data of the legendary beast, the "Dragon", and it is said to have the potential to grow into a mighty Digimon. Its Special Move is firing an iron sphere from its mouth (Metal Cannon). Signature Move: It is able to fire an iron sphere even while charging, although it's more powerful if it fires after standing still and accumulating power (Dash Metal).

digimons.name: Dracomon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalAn ancient, pure-blooded Dragon Digimon that is said to be the "Progenitor" of all Dramon-type Digimon. It possesses physical ability to a degree that could not be imagined from its small build, and both its power and its quick wits are top class among Child Digimon. Although its personality is ferocious, Dracomon can show its gentle side only to the others it has recognized. It has wings, but it is unable to fly because they are not sufficiently developed. Also, it has a nature whose primary trait is wanting to collect "shiny things", with an especially strange attachment to gems and metals, and it eats and assimilates its favorite things. Its Special Moves are breathing out a high temperature sigh at the opponent (Baby Breath), and spinning its whole body to deliver a blow with its tail (Tail Smash). Amongst the scales that cover Dracomon's whole body, there is one scale that is called the "Gekirin". If it is touched there, Dracomon loses its mind to an excess of anger, and indiscriminately fires its "G Shurunen", a beam shot in which it makes the horns on its head glow intensely, then fires from its mouth.

digimons.name: Dracomon (X-Antibody)
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalAn ancient, pure-blooded Dragon Digimon that is said to be the "Progenitor" of all Dramon-type Digimon. It possesses physical ability to a degree that could not be imagined from its small build, and both its power and its quick wits are top class among Child Digimon. Although its personality is ferocious, Dracomon can show its gentle side only to the others it has recognized. It has wings, but it is unable to fly because they are not sufficiently developed. Also, it has a nature whose primary trait is wanting to collect "shiny things", with an especially strange attachment to gems and metals, and it eats and assimilates its favorite things. Its Special Moves are breathing out a high temperature sigh at the opponent (Baby Breath), and spinning its whole body to deliver a blow with its tail (Tail Smash). Amongst the scales that cover Dracomon's whole body, there is one scale that is called the "Gekirin". If it is touched there, Dracomon loses its mind to an excess of anger, and indiscriminately fires its "G Shurunen", a beam shot in which it makes the horns on its head glow intensely, then fires from its mouth.



The effect on Dracomon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



Its wings have developed further, allowing it to fly for short periods of time.



However, the true use of its wings lies in the changes to how it attacks rather than how it flies. By having its wings be relocated to its arms, it is able to raise a wind in the direction it is facing, and is now capable of attacking enemies over a vast range by letting the flames that it spews out from its mouth (Baby Blaze) be carried by that wind. Also, in order to release the heat within its body, which has increased because of the X-Antibody, the horns on its head have taken on the function of radiating heat, and so they reach ultra-high temperatures. The power of its "Smash Horn", where it charges at the enemy with those ultra-high temperature horns, appears to greatly surpass that of the Child level.

digimons.name: Dracumon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalThe Dark Area's most mischievous Digimon. For the sake of a prank, it will meet the challenge unflinchingly even if it is accompanied by some risk. It once nearly got itself killed trying to graffiti the faces of all four of the Four Holy Beasts...(it's unknown whether it succeeded). It was once a bloodsucking Digimon, but these days it forgets to suck blood, and it seems it's trying to play some kind of trick on the Royal Knights. It is said that those who look into the "Eye of Nightmare" cast from the evil eyes on the palms of its hands have their hearts completely dominated by Dracumon. Also, appropriately for a vampire, it seems to have a biting attack technique using its fangs called "Undead Fang".

digimons.name: Duskmon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Digimon that possesses power over Darkness which bears the might of one of the legendary Ten Warriors. The regret of various extinct species of Digimon and the "Forbidden Data" on the Net transformed into intense dark energy, and coalesced into Duskmon. The dark energy exists in order to oppose the light of holy beings, and the one who possesses power over Light is the flip side of the same coin. It has a thoroughly evil personality, so it is both callous and cruel. It is the possessor of demon lord-like dignity that is overflowing with perfectionism and confidence. It is invincible in battle when wielding its swords, and does not hesitate with its inhuman attacks. Its Special Moves are making the eyes all over its body shine and placing the opponent under hypnosis (Geist Abend), and absorbing the opponent's power with its two demonic "Blut Evolution" swords and making it its own (Eroberung). By the way, due to the ability of the three heads and seven eyes on its armor to act on their own as if they were separate creatures, true evil is sealed in them.

Its body is made up of vibrant colored pencils, and it is always drawing pictures that it likes no matter the time and place. The pencils can also be used for its attack "Colorful Change", which changes depending on the colors used. The attack "Colorful Change" turns fire-elemental when red is used, water-elemental when blue is used, grass-elemental when green is used, and so on and so forth. digimons.name: Elizamon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA Reptile Digimon characterized by its frill, which is soft like fabric. Its ears, which look like ribbons, are so good at picking up noises that they can react to even the slightest of sounds in their surroundings. It usually prefers inhabiting quiet areas, and folds its ears to shut out noise when sleeping. A species with an elegant personality, it is often regarded as cute, along with its frill and ears, but it also has a ferocious side where it spreads its frill wide and leaps at invading enemies.



Its Special Moves are mincing the opponent while rapidly spinning its frill (Frilled Cutter), and using the high-speed rotation of its frill to glide at low altitude, and landing a blow from its tail that makes use of its momentum (Helicop-Tail).

digimons.name: Espimon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Cyborg Digimon that immediately flies in to investigate whenever it catches wind of gossip or suspicion circulating in the Digital World. It will boldly go undercover in order to find out the truth, even in places inhabited by dangerous Digimon. When it toggles its eyes to Search Mode, it is able to clearly see objects several kilometers away. Also, it activates its "Divanish", which applies an optical camouflage to its body, by pressing the switch on its abdomen, and blends in with its surroundings, allowing it to perform reconnaissance without being discovered. Its Signature Move is the self-propulsive, timed "Mot Bomb", which it uses according to the situation, such as attacking the enemy or making a decoy. Rumor has it that the Crack Team measures their cracking ability by controlling Espimon, but it is unclear whether this is true or not.

As its wings are not very developed, it's not so much able to fly as it is able to glide; to make up for that, it is able to run about craggy mountains at great speed with its powerful legs. Because it has a rough temperament, you must be careful because if you approach carelessly, you will get fiercely attacked. Its Special Moves are scratching the opponent with its wing claws (Scratch Smash), and an attack it unleashes using its powerful leg strength (Falco Rush).

digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA subspecies of Falcomon whose wings have developed to allow it to fly freely in the air, in contrast to normal Falcomon, who possess powerful leg strength. Despite its ability to fly, it seems to be obsessed with making its appearance from above by flying in on a kite, like a ninja. Furthermore, it also specialises in dropping small bombs from above while it is riding its kite (Uchitake Otoshi).
