digimons.name: Belphemon (X-Antibody)
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalIt is said that once every thousand years, Belphemon awakens from its prolonged slumber and regains its natural form. When Belphemon awakens from its slumber, it transforms into an incarnation of rage, and anything that enters its field of vision becomes a target for destruction. It is said that just by suffering Belphemon: Rage Mode's roar, Digimon of the Perfect level and below will have their data disintegrated and die instantly, and not even Ultimate Digimon can escape unharmed. Its Special Moves are black flames cast from the chains coiled around its body (Lampranthus), and a slash attack unleashed from its claws, which are clad in the flames of hell (Gift of Darkness). In addition, the data of Digimon who were felled by the Digimon crowned as the Seven Great Demon Lords is not reincarnated, but is sent to the heart of the Dark Area to become the flesh and blood of the Demon Lords.



The effect on Belphemon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



Its destructive impulses have intensified and instincts have sharpened; it will utterly and completely crush those it seeks to destroy. It will first aim for and brutally pulverise the Digimon acting as the beacon of hope for the opposing army, crushing the hopeful hearts of the entire enemy faction. It then continues pounding on the opposing army, which has lost its will to fight, until it is satisfied and has laid waste to the army. Its Special Move is causing its Crown of Sloth to overflow with power, and firing a crimson energy wave from its claws at maximum output (Seventh Penetrate).

digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Demon Lord Digimon said to be sealed in the deepest parts of the Dark Area. As the strength it possesses is too immense, its data is said to have been put in a sleep state by the Digital World's system, although the truth of the matter is uncertain. Because it has fallen into a deep sleep, it cannot unleash attacks on its own, but it is able to inflict damage on Digimon with just its snores, and for that reason it won't be easy to attack Belphemon: Sleep Mode in its sleep. digimons.name: Black War Greymon (X-Antibody)
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalFeared as the "Jet-black Dragon Warrior", it is a Virus-species War Greymon. Although its creed and principles are the polar opposite of those of the Virus Busters War Greymon, it exists for the sake of its own peculiar "Justice". It detests cowardice and foul play, and it doesn't consider itself a fellow of vulgar Digimon, even if they are of the same Virus-species. How exactly it converted into a Virus is a mystery, and the "Brave Shield" equipped to its back is not engraved with the Crest of Courage. Its Special Move is similar to War Greymon's "Gaia Force", except that it takes all of the "negative emotions" within this world and concentrates them into one spot, and then fires it (Ankoku no Gaia Force).



The effect on Black War Greymon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



Its negative power has been condensed to its maximum, accelerating its cunning to seize victory by any means necessary. The toughness of its "Dramon Killers" has been raised to their strongest, comparable to that of the "Brave Shield", and so it now possesses perfected equipment that unite both offense and defense. Due to its fighting style, in which it instantly plunges into the heart of the enemy with the verniers it has equipped to its back, which boast explosive acceleration at the expense of its ability to fly for extended periods, it has truly become the strongest form of ground combat Digimon, a "Land War Hero". Evading its "Hades Force", where it continuously fires its Special Move "Ankoku no Gaia Force" at ultra-high speed, seems to be impossible. Furthermore, its "Afterburst", which accelerates its attacks using verniers added onto its "Dramon Killers", is also a one-hit knockout technique.

digimons.name: Blastmon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA super-heavyweight Digimon with a mineral body. It is clad in a hard crystal armor that regenerates when broken, and boasts a number of various, powerful techniques, so its slowly moving form is the epitome of an impregnable moving fortress. Because of its glittering body and power, it calls itself the "most beautiful, sublime creature."



Its "Diamond Machine Gun", which fires off the crystals throughout its body like a machine gun, alongside an intense punch, can sweep through hundreds of enemies in one shot, and its "Diamond Hedgehog", which capitalizes on its hard body and great weight, is just it curling up its body and rolling around, but there's nothing that can keep its original shape after being squashed by that. Although its "Crystal Breath", a technique in which it absorbs sunlight into its body, then spews it out as an extremely high-temperature, high-pressure laser, has the weakness of only being usable in daytime, the destructive power it displays more than makes up for its faults.

⇨ OriginalA Fairy Digimon in the form of a plant clad in armor, it is a kind-hearted knight that fights to protect nature. It accumulates energy by absorbing sunlight through the flowers on its shoulders. The power it exhibits once that energy has been raised to its limit is said to even rival that of the Royal Knights. It has the ability to turn any foul weather into fine weather, and creates battlefields that always work to its advantage when out in the open.



Its Special Moves are shooting countless seeds from the petals on its left shoulder like a machine gun (Multiple Seed), and piercing the enemy with the flower spear it holds in its right hand (Sprout Rush). In addition, it fires an extremely wide beam with the huge sword of light that emerges from within its flower spear only when it has bloomed (Gran del Sol).

digimons.name: Breakdramon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA gigantic Machine Dragon Digimon said to exist in order to destroy everything in existence. During evolution, it succeeded in obtaining the design data for various construction equipment through hacking, and thus it possesses power and ability surpassing other Machine Digimon. However, in exchange for excellent mechanical performance, its organic parts were reduced almost to 0, and its motives and emotions were lost. For that reason, it does not falter when taking damage, and it is feared as the ultimate dragon of destruction that will continue destroying until it rusts away. Its "Destroyed Rush", in which it repeatedly strikes the earth at extremely high speed with its left and right shovel arms, can split solid earth, its "Infinity Boring", in which it operates and fires all the drills throughout its body, can smash mountains, and its "Gravity Press", in which it flattens the target with its entire body mass, can crush anything. Absolutely nothing remains standing wherever Breakdramon has passed through.

digimons.name: Bryweludramon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalAn Ultimate Legend-Arms shield Digimon, virtually all of its body is comprised of shields and has taken the form of a dragon. By attaining the data of "Legendary Shields" from mythology and video games, it evolved to become a shield with absolute hardness that cannot be scratched by any attack. While appearance-wise it seems to be made from Red Digizoid, the extent of its hardness cannot be analyzed. Bryweludramon has two standalone AI units, "Gause" and "Fay", which allow it to see in all directions. "Gause" and "Fay" also possess barriers made from flames, and are able to extend the range of their barriers to cover even Bryweludramon. Because "Gause" and "Fay" are capable of acting independently of Bryweludramon no matter how far they are separated, it is said that they are even capable of covering the entire world with their barriers. Although Bryweludramon may be the strongest shield, it seems that its barriers have been broken and bested by its nemesis, Durandamon.



Its Special Moves are unleashing a blaze from its flaming wings (Guren Storm), and detaching its wings to put up a barrier of flame while charging towards the enemy (Blast Smash). Transformation is the most valuable asset of a Legend-Arms; should one wield Bryweludramon while it is transformed into a shield, no enemy would be willing to keep up their assault.

digimons.name: Callismon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA Demon Beast Digimon with an appearance resembling a bear. Although it is considered to be a Digimon that evolved from the Gryzmon line, all Callismon are mutants that evolved from individuals that underwent data abnormalities. It is unknown whether the data abnormalities responsible for this occurred suddenly or were caused intentionally, and because its population is small, there are many mysteries surrounding it such as its ecology and evolution requirements.



It has extremely high combat ability, owing to its hugely developed arms and armaments, and exhibits a ferocious nature that will not stop attacking the opponent until they are defeated.



Its Special Moves are tearing the enemy apart with its sharp claws, causing their data to disintegrate (Deep Forest), and firing homing shots from the three gun barrels equipped to its right arm (Rodeo Bullet).

digimons.name: Ceresmon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalOne of the Olympos XII, Ceresmon is a monstrous, gigantic bird Digimon that carries on its back the "Karpos Hulē", a forest bearing the Digital World's greatest sweets and famous fruits. With a body composed of rocks and rich, fertile soil, Ceresmon's soaring form is definitely the epitome of an island floating in the sky.



Sitting on the head of Ceresmon is "Ceresmon Medium", which serves as its true form. "Ceresmon Medium" has practically nil fighting strength and so rarely, if ever, comes out in public on its own, but it is said that it will occasionally show itself unattended by the monstrous bird to those who earn its trust. Its personality is filled with gentleness and a kind heart, and it is said that it offers fruit from the "Karpos Hulē" to hungry Digimon, and shelters injured Digimon in its woods until they recuperate. However, it will reverse its attitude and bring terror as if a demonic forest to those who forget the blessings granted by the forests and land, and unnecessarily injure the trees or pollute the soil.



Its Special Move "Island Freefall", in which it slams its huge body against the opponent, inflicts damage from the intense shock wave and vibrations around the area where it falls. For its "Burning Blood Shell", it fires a magma bodily fluid from its mouth as an enormous flame shot. The unripe fruit from the "Karpos Hulē" has high concentrations of poison, and its "Fruits Flechette", in which it scatters them over a wide range, transforms its surroundings into a land of death with that poison upon impact. However, the poison changes into high-quality fertilizer after several days, and then it is reborn as a fertile land.

Its heart and thoughts are completely Dark Side, and it is nothing more than the "Digital Hazard" that brings calamity to the Digital World. It is clad in black, demonic armor refined from high purity Chrome Digizoid just like Dukemon, and its right hand can become the demonic lance "Balmung" while its left hand can become the demonic shield "Gorgon". Its Special Moves are the powerful barrage of attacks of its demonic lance (Demon's Disaster), and firing a dark wave which corrodes everything from the demonic shield in its left hand (Judecca Prison).

Its Body, made of "Red Digizoid" which was repurified from the super-metal Chrondigizoit to only improve its hardness, is able to deflect any attack and destroy anything. Chaosdramon is also the Digimon that the leader of the Crack Team primarily employs as its agent. Its Special Move is a superdreadnought-class energy wave fired from its two artillery cannons (Hyper Mugen Cannon).



The effect on Chaosdramon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



Although it exhibits several times the power and firepower compared to fellow Ultimate Mugendramon, it is difficult to tame due to it being destructive and autonomous, so it chooses its own user. Having sacrificed its speed as a result of the weight of its "Red Digizoid", it compensated by acquiring its "Super Genocide Attack", where it seizes the enemy with the "Chaos Crusher" on its right arm, breaks open their armor, and launches organic missiles stored in a portion of that arm at their insides. Its "Red Digizoid" body is exactly what allows for this terrifying, self-destructive point-blank shooting to be feasible.

digimons.name: Chaosmon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalNormally, when a Jogress occurs, the Digicores of the two Digimon are completely fused and reborn as a new Digimon; however, Chaosmon retains each of the Digicores of the Digimon before the Jogress, and maintains its form in a very incomplete state. Chaosmon is the codename for Digimon who "should not exist", and according to the "Central Dogma" of the Digital World, are absolute impossible singularities (bugs). Due to its extremely unstable existence, its lifespan is very short, and it is conjectured that the program being run by the Digital World's managing system which eliminates bugs is causing its lifespan to shorten. This Chaosmon is believed to be born from the Jogress of Bancho Leomon and Darkdramon, and the faces of each Digimon are visible on its arms. Its Special Moves are an unstoppable bisecting slash unleashed from the "BAN-TYO Blade" equipped to its "Bancho Arm" (Haou Ryoudanken), and firing off its own digital cells from the "Gigastick Cannon" equipped to its "Darkdra Arm" (Dark Prominence).

digimons.name: Chronomon: Destroy Mode
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalThe berserk form of Chronomon. It is a legendary monster that is said to have abandoned its role of maintaining the stability of space-time, and risen in revolt against the system that governs time. While it was restoring space-time, the various forms of malice in the Digital World flowed into Chronomon all at once, corroding it like a virus, and causing it to run wild. By abusing the power of time that Chronomon originally possessed, it hacks into memories engraved into the Digital World, downloads a variety of techniques to itself, and then goes on a rampage.



Its Special Move is forcibly restoring the past data of opponents it points at, causing them to explode from within due to the vast volume of data (Finger Bomb). Also, even after going berserk, it still has "Holy Flare", in which it incinerates the opponent.



Finally, its "Chrono Devolution", where it converts the Digital World's time data into energy and unleashes it, instantly ages anyone that comes into contact with that energy, turning them into data dust.

digimons.name: Chronomon: Holy Mode
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA God Man Digimon that is also said to be a materialization of the system that governs time. The flow of time in the Digital World is truly vague, and disturbances in time occasionally occur due to conflicts between powerful Digimon or cataclysms. It is Chronomon who appears on those occasions, tasked with restoring space-time. Once it restores space-time, the fact that it manifested also disappears along with the space-time disturbance, so no one has seen Chronomon. For that reason, Chronomon's existence is only mentioned in a few legends.



Its Special Moves are sacred flames that incinerate beings who maliciously try to distort space-time, and even erase the fact that they existed (Holy Flare), and an indefensible blow in which it swings its wings like blades, severing the opponent along with space-time (Chronos Crop).

The "Zenith Gate" is sealed by 360 doors, and "The Key" held by Clavis Angemon acts as the master key to every door. "The Key" is a special key that only Clavis Angemon can handle, so one could say that Clavis Angemon itself is a part of the key. It is said that through the power embedded in the key, Clavis Angemon is able to wield offensive power so great that it could cause the Digital World's collapse, but only against enemies attempting to break through the doors.

digimons.name: Craniummon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalThe Digimon which best understood decorum among the Royal Knights. It is a perfectionist, and competes with the other Royal Knights Digimon for the top two mission completion rates for Yggdrasill's orders. When fighting with an opponent, its policy is always to defeat it with one-on-one combat, and if the opponent is a formidable enemy, its delight is supreme. Craniummon's armor had its code modified by Yggdrasill, and was changed into Black Digizoid. It has become possible for it to generate a weapon and shield from its armor by accessing its data. Its Special Move is firing a sonic wave at supersonic speeds by rapidly spinning its magic spear, "Claíomh Solais" (End Waltz). Those who suffer this technique continue to "Dance" until all of their data is pulverized by the shock wave. Also, when it invokes its "God Bless", its magic shield "Avalon" defends in every direction with an impregnable wall, and it is able to negate any attack for just three seconds.

digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalThe Digimon which best understood decorum among the Royal Knights. It is a perfectionist, and competes with the other Royal Knights Digimon for the top two mission completion rates for Yggdrasill's orders. When fighting with an opponent, its policy is always to defeat it with one-on-one combat, and if the opponent is a formidable enemy, its delight is supreme. Craniummon's armor had its code modified by Yggdrasill, and was changed into Black Digizoid. It has become possible for it to generate a weapon and shield from its armor by accessing its data.



The effect on Craniummon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



The Black Digizoid covering its whole body has become even sturdier, such that regular attacks inflict damage back upon the attacker rather than injuring Craniummon itself. Also, it has stowed the strongest magic shield "Avalon" on its back to show off its confidence in not needing to use it.



Its Special Move is removing the blades on both of its arms and throwing them as tomahawks (Grand Gríðr). In addition, it spins the "Kyūkyoku Senjūken Dáinsleif", transformed from its magic spear "Claíomh Solais", at the speed of light, reducing targets within a 3 km radius to ash (Hjaðningar Waltz). It is said that those who have witnessed this technique are turned to data dust without even realizing that they were "attacked".

digimons.name: Craniummon + Enbarrmon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA select number of Royal Knights will sometimes recruit Digimon from where they are dispatched to as allies in order to execute their assigned missions. The way they obtain these allies varies depending on the nature of the mission, but Craniummon is said to acquire allies as its subordinates by challenging Digimon it recognizes as formidable to one-on-one combat and making them submit. This Riding Mode is a form where Craniummon recruited Enbarrmon as its mount after defeating it during a certain mission. It seems that the perfectionist Craniummon had its eyes on Enbarrmon's mobility in order to carry out its missions more efficiently. Although they had a relationship where they waged fierce battles against one another, they acknowledged each other's strengths and built a strong, trusting relationship, which resulted in them gaining astounding mobility and offensive power. Its Special Move is a charging thrust from the Claíomh Solais with Enbarrmon running at full speed (Ruthless Charge). Due to Enbarrmon's charging power at maximum speed, combined with the mass of the two Digimon, and Craniummon's physical strength, most of the Digimon that get stabbed are scattered without leaving any trace. Also, the "never die" protection that is bestowed upon Enbarrmon's riders affected Craniummon's magic shield "Avalon", and its "God Bless", an omnidirectional defense used only while mounted, no longer has the three-second time limit and permanently negates any attack.

⇨ OriginalA Giant Bird Digimon whose body is clad in gold armor. The armor that covers its whole body is made of Chrome Digizoid, so it deflects every attack. Also, Crossmon is even said to be an evolved form of the Perfect Digimon, Parrotmon. It is said that it is Crossmon's duty to annihilate the invaders that enter the Digital World. Its Special Moves are performing a ramming attack with its full metal body (Kaiser Phoenix), and a white ray which reduces the opponent to ash (Mystic Break).
Crossmon was adopted from a winning Digimon entry in the "Digimon Web Dot-art Contest" which belonged to Mr. Shun Nabetou from Fukuoka prefecture.

digimons.name: Cthyllamon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalCthyllamon inhabits the depths of the Net Ocean, and is known by the alias "Phantom of the Ocean" due to the fact that only the skull pattern on its chest can be seen floating eerily in the dark sea. It has a crafty and cunning disposition; instead of actively fighting on its own, it employs aquatic Digimon of a lower Level than itself by brainwashing them. It shares many similarities with Marin Angemon, such as its appearance and the fact that it is rarely ever seen, but the relationship between the two remains unknown.



Its Special Move "Ocean Hell", in which it steals the opponent's fighting spirit with an aura of endless terror akin to the darkness of the ocean depths, sometimes reduces the Digimon that suffer this technique to being Cthyllamon's puppets. Its "Buccal Rush", in which it opens its mouth wide and attacks with its three long, flexible tongues in a whip-like manner, and its "Aqua Grinder", where it generates an intense whirlpool that bores into the opponent's body like a drill, possess destructive power that is unimaginable from its tiny physique.

digimons.name: Dark Knightmon (X-Antibody)
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalDark Knightmon is the fused figure of Skull Knightmon and Deadly Axemon, who have exchanged cups of brotherhood. Dark Knightmon, who brings the older brother's ingenuity together with the younger brother's mobility, has become a first-class warrior. The skills of Dark Knightmon, who can use the "Twin Spear" it wields to thrust, slash, sweep, or throw as the situation calls for, are very advanced, and it is said there are few people powerful enough to fight Dark Knightmon fairly to its face and defeat it. While Dark Knightmon possesses that much competency, it will use any means to achieve its goals and won't hesitate to get its hands dirty, and sometimes it will even be willing to betray its own comrades. Dark Knightmon, who is furnished to an implacable depth with merit, is an opponent that you don't want to turn into an enemy, if you can help it.



The effect on Dark Knightmon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



The power it possessed as a single Digimon has increased even more, causing it to become an Ultimate, resulting in this form. Its evil intentions have also been amplified, and it aims not only for the world but even for a place among the Seven Great Demon Lords. Its Special Moves are crushing the opponent's limbs with a tornado created by its "Vortex-spear" (Cruel Tornado), and by wielding its "Cyclone Deathscythe", which fuses its "Shoulder Blade" and spear together, splitting the opponent apart with a cross-slash (Deadly Break Lost).

digimons.name: Darkdramon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Cyborg Digimon which is believed to be the weapon of last resort for the mechanized "D-Brigade". Although this is information that stubbornly remains part of the rumor mill, it is said that a Tankdramon, shot down during an operation to eliminate a "target" designated "Codename: BAN-TYO", was retrieved and evolved to Darkdramon at the D-Brigade research facility it was left at. It seems that on the verge of its evolution, a large quantity of "Dark Matter" was applied, and after its evolution it ran wild and broke out, so currently even the D-Brigade cannot secure Darkdramon's whereabouts. It is said that even now it is hunting "Codename: BAN-TYO"...Its Special Move "Dark Roar" is a bold move in which it fires Dark Matter as energy shots, and it is said that there is nothing in this world that can suffer that attack and survive. Also, its right hand is equipped with the "Gigastick Lance", which rivals Dukemon's holy lance "Gram".

digimons.name: Darkness Bagramon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalThe digixrosed form of Dark Knightmon and Bagramon. By uniting the dark knight and the fiendish demon lord it became the greatest emperor of evil. Its "Imperium Vicious", the evil power spilling out of its body, symbolizes that strength, and if a weak evil is bathed in it then it immediately becomes a grovelling subordinate. Even if you try to resist, it is considered difficult to maintain your sense of self if you are glared at by Dark Knightmon, who exists within its chest. According to one theory, it appears to be planning on destroying all good, in order to fill the world with evil and obtain a world that it can manipulate at will. Even though there are probably some Digimon whose strength is not outdone even by Darkness Bagramon itself, it is said that in order to designate its plan as something guaranteed, it expands its power by bringing useful Digimon under its control, and watches out for opportunities for the opposition. Even if the opponent seems to be keeping their distance, when it becomes aware of them it will rip their soul out with its "God of Death Snatcher", one of its Digimon-manipulating techniques. For an opponent whose existence has no worth, it instantly destroys all of their data with its "Eternal Darkmare", in which it flaps its jet-black wings. The darkness held within the hearts of humans and Digimon is intensified and fused with Darkness Bagramon's own fathomless power. If that power is released from the red eyes in its chest with its "Balefire-Eyes", then all of its surroundings will be transformed into nothingness.

It is called the "Digicore Predator" because its own activity is dependent on the Digicores of other Digimon, and is nothing but a threat to them. By continuously preying on the Digicores of other Digimon, it is active despite its deceased condition, and since it stores vast amounts of Digicore information within its body, its entire body is covered in restraints, and so it is barely able to function as a single Digimon. Its Special Moves are blasting everything away except the enemy's Digicore (Metal Impulse) and "DORU Din".

digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalSince it doesn't have its own Digicore, this type of program cannot be classified as a Digimon, and although it appears solid, it has no actual substance. If it detects a Digicore it will absorb it into its body and disassemble it, then reassemble it in a perpetually repeating set of processes named "Process 0" through "Process F". Although it is a simple program, it is conjectured that defeating it is within the realm of impossibility. Unless there are Digicores nearby, it will go into stasis, but as long as there are Digicores it will not cease.

digimons.name: Demon (X-Antibody)
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA Demon Lord Digimon that leads the many Devil and Fallen Angel Digimon. Like Devimon, Demon was originally an Angel Digimon, and a particularly high-ranking one. However, because it raged in fury or rebellion, against a being of goodness in the Digital World (perhaps the very human that created the Digital World), it was deleted to the Dark Area (the graveyard of deleted data). It has vowed to one day conquer the Digital World, in revenge against the being of goodness. Also, it is plotting to secretly revive the "Super-Ultimate Digimon", who led the rebellion and was the strongest among the Ultimates. Its Special Move is the extremely high-temperature flames of hell (Flame Inferno). Those who incur this technique burn up without a trace.



The effect on Demon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



By taking in the X-Antibody, the "Crown of Wrath" manifested above its head, so Demon now increases its power the more its anger grows. It is said that when that anger exceeds its limit, power surpassing even that of Super Ultimate Digimon bursts forth. Its Special Moves are firing supergravity lasers from its shoulders and part of its abdomen, erasing all of its surroundings and reducing them to ash (Seventh Graviton), and a final secret technique where it transforms into a blazing demon god enveloped in its Flame Inferno (Inferno Burst). It would be difficult for even the Royal Knights to stop Demon once it has turned into a blazing demon god with the Crown of Wrath bursting into red-hot flames.

digimons.name: Devitamamon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA Mutation-type Ultimate Digimon that is said to have Dark Evolved from Digitamamon. Although defining "Evil" in the Digital World is very difficult, Devitamamon is a being akin to a "Pandora's box", filled with all the evils of this world. It turns everything it sees and touches into a target for its hatred, and recites and masters magic through a lost, ancient high-level programming language. The effects of its magic are used solely for "Destruction" and nothing else. Its Special Move is spewing a dark gas that deprives the opponent of their sight, gnaws away at their spirit, and then digitally decomposes them from the surface of their body (Black Death Cloud).
It was adopted from a winning Digimon entry in the "Bandai-Town FAX Service Digimon Illustration Contest" which belonged to Mr. Kanai Kazuma from Saitama prefecture.

digimons.name: Diablomon (X-Antibody)
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalIt repeatedly absorbs all the data on the Network in order to evolve and grow larger, and is depleting the Digital World to the brink of destruction. A Diablomon that has absorbed a lot of data becomes convinced that it is an all-knowing and all-powerful being, and it takes pleasure in destruction and slaughter. However, when this Digimon congregates in great numbers, its raison d'être is made clear; as that ultimate goal is to hijack a military computer and try to destroy the Real World as well with a nuclear strike, this is a terrifying Digimon. Its Special Move is firing a powerful shot of destructive energy from its chest-cannon (Catastrophe Cannon).



The effect on Diablomon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



The most heinous of Digimon, shaped even more by a harsh ecosystem. Taking in the X-Antibody caused the thought routines within its Digicore to run wild, and it repeatedly destroys the Digital World in order to prove its own belief that it is an omniscient, omnipotent god. It uses any means necessary to achieve its goals, and has learned how to set cruel and cunning traps and maneuver itself so that it always gains the upper hand. It shows up in front of the enemy with an appearance like that of a balancing toy, using its tail as a pivot point, and gives off a feeling of instinctive revulsion through its strange movements and the attacks it unleashes from odd poses like a mollusk. Its Special Moves are rotating its body like a spinning top, and tearing the enemy to pieces with its enormous claws and hidden arms (Spooky Zapper), and absorbing the data of enemies it gazes at with the twelve eyes all over its body (Fatal Gaze). Also, its "Rewind Abyss 13", which is invoked when it opens its hidden thirteenth eye, is the vilest, most wicked curse that causes a Digimon to forcibly degenerate at the end of the countdown.

digimons.name: Dianamon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalOne of the Olympos XII, this God Man Digimon presides over water and ice, and is able to fight even when its surroundings are at absolute zero. Just as the moon has two sides (light and dark), its personality is of a two-sided nature, and its beauty conceals terrifying power. Its Special Moves are conjuring an illusion using the mysterious power of the moon, and cutting down those it's deemed as enemies in an instant (Crescent Harken), and pulling out a sleek, sharp, long and dazzling arrow of ice from the protuberances on its back, then firing it (Arrow of Artemis). It also uses "Goodnight Moon", bathing the opponent in moonlight emitted from the "Goodnight Sisters" on both of its legs to lure the opponent into sleep.

digimons.name: Diarbbitmon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalAn astute Beast Knight Digimon that protects the nature-rich land inhabited by many Beast Digimon. It has a gentle personality and prefers spending its time quietly while interacting with the Digimon around it. If an enemy that threatens the land appears, it will draw its two cherished swords, "Móralltach" and "Beagalltach", and drive the enemy back with its nimble movements. Even though Diarbbitmon is usually well-mannered, it will invoke its rage against those who ravage the land, and chop them up until not even a trace of them remains; it will also keep pursuing their allies until they are annihilated.



Its Special Moves are slashing the enemy with its boundless swordsmanship (Trusgain), and summoning two magic spears which home in on them (Buidhedearg). In addition, it cuts off the enemy's path of retreat with its "Buck Strash", in which it minces the enemy as it leaves behind high-speed afterimages in all directions around them.

digimons.name: Dijiangmon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA Mutation Digimon with a grotesque appearance, whose whole body is covered in leather. Since it doesn't speak nor try to express anything with its body, it usually just stands at a spot in an eerie silence. Generally speaking, it has no interest in self-expression, and is an evil Digimon that specializes only in robbing others of life.



It slips into crowds of Digimon from out of nowhere and sends out a signal, in a manner similar to telepathy, that stimulates their combat instinct and causes the Digimon to fight each other, bringing about chaos.



Its Special Moves are blowing the enemy away with a shock wave generated by swinging its long tail (Kyōsenkai), and binding enemies using its extensible arms, then knocking them down from the sky (Jurenshōkoku). In addition, in its "Konton Akūkyo", in which it opens the zippers on its body to pull the opponent in, not even Dijiangmon itself knows where they will disappear to once they have been swallowed.

digimons.name: Dinorexmon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalThis carnivorous Dinosaur Digimon is named the "King of Terror" due to the strength it possesses far in excess of other Dinosaur Digimon, as well as the unparalleled ferocious nature it displays in battle. It seizes the opponent with its talons, which are almost half as long as its body, then snaps and brandishes its gigantic jaws at them to end their life. Its exceedingly brutal behaviour gives it a battle style that flourishes in a world where only the fittest survive, and is probably the reason it is called the "King". Also, partly due to it fighting with other Dinorexmon, it is said that their population is very small. Its Special Moves are seizing and killing the opponent with its talons (Splatter Hunting), and firing extremely high-temperature grenades, with a semi-fluid form similar to magma, from its mouth (Ogre Flame). Even if these extremely high-temperature grenades don't hit the opponent, they nevertheless raze the surrounding area the moment they land.

digimons.name: Dinotigermon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalInjured Digimon have become its prey. It is an Ancient Beast Digimon which took in the metal elements of the earth, super-hardened its whole body, and evolved from one of the few Saber Leomon which have repeated and survived endless battles, where the weak are food for the strong. Its movements are not swift compared to Saber Leomon, but it possesses almost twice as much tough flesh and physical strength, and with its big, sharp, sword-like fangs, it forcibly brings down even Digimon larger than itself and which possess thick skin or armor. Other Digimon fear Dinotigermon, who possesses daring and wild predatory instinct, and do not approach. Its Special Moves are pinning down the enemy, then stabbing and tearing through them with its fangs (Ground Fang), and swinging down its fangs from an elevation, instantly cutting them to pieces (Highland Fang).

digimons.name: Dominimon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA Dominion Digimon also known as a phantom. It acts on its own accord without being bound by the angelic chain of command. If a powerful enemy emerges, it will join forces with Clavis Angemon and Slash Angemon to defeat it. It is a rare species that suddenly manifests akin to a mutation when the balance between light and darkness in the Digital World is disrupted, and so very few have ever seen it. With a personality that values its entire race over any individual, it doesn't treat its own life as being that important, and will launch a death-defying special attack to get out of a predicament without hesitation.



Its Special Moves are piercing the enemy with a blade of energy that manifests on its arm (Final Excalibur), firing ultra-high-temperature lasers from the shields on its shoulders in every direction (Zero Heavens), and emanating a holy aura from its whole body, granting power to Angel-species Digimon in its surroundings at the cost of shortening its own life (Devotion Field).

digimons.name: Dorbickmon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalThe general of the Fire-fury Army of the "Big Death-Stars". It leads a multitude of dragon Digimon in perfect order, and destroys its enemies with its overwhelming battle strength no matter the combat situation. It excels in both power and speed, and its keen intuition honed by its wealth of combat experience allows it to adapt to any situation in battle. Its personality is one that prefers to see flames of destruction surge across the battlefield; as such, it stirs up strife whenever it comes across a peaceful area. Not only that, it revels in the sight of other Digimon and even the world being incinerated to ashes.



"Tyrant Collbrande", a flaming sword formed from the building rage from battle, demonstrates immense power equivalent to Dorbickmon's fury. Even alone, it is able to take down entire armies by piercing a dragon's vein within the land, altering the terrain to damage groups of enemies (Burning the Dragon), and using its ultra-high-temperature "Dragon Breastonic Fire" that reduces anything it touches to ashes.

It has sacred hybrid equipment combining "Red Digizoid", "Blue Digizoid", and "Gold Digizoid", which are rare metals, as well as Chrome Digizoid boasting the highest known purity. Since its form was remodeled in order to demonstrate its holy power, the lance of light emitted from its sacred lance Gram was amplified, and it acquired a new Special Move called "Sieg Saber" which lengthens it. In addition, it is said that Dukemon's red mantle from before acquiring the X-Antibody was given to the hero, Leomon.

Boasting strength that puts it among the strongest Legend-Arms capable of transforming into swords, it is said that wielding Durandamon in sword form will surely bring about victory. Its slashing attacks are fierce enough to cut through any sort of defense, although there have been records that only the strongest of the Legend-Arms Digimon capable of transforming into shields are able to withstand Durandamon's attacks.



Its Special Moves are focusing its fighting spirit into the blades on both arms and slicing the enemy with them (Zwanglänze), and spinning its body to slice multiple enemies in one fell swoop (Thron Messer). While both attacks are powerful enough to take enemies down in one hit, Durandamon's greatest appeal is still its ability to transform into a weapon and unleash slashing attacks.

digimons.name: EBEmon (X-Antibody)
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA Cyborg Digimon that was artificially created from a Vademon that was captured, and had its configuration data analyzed and improved. In a certain country's facility, called "Area 51", it seems they were using and building extraterrestrial technology, but the truth is shrouded in mystery. Its Special Move "Brain Rupture" is firing a cracking program into the opponent's brain with the gun it holds in its left hand, then absorbing all the data stored in their brain. Its "Planet Destroyer" is a technique that releases all of its accumulated power and fires it off from the gun in its right hand, so it is said that it's able to instantly destroy a single planet. It is said that that certain country is covertly conducting research and development on Digimon in order to take possession of the Digital World.
EBEmon was adopted from a winning Digimon illustration entry in the "Digimon Web Dot-art Contest" which belonged to Mr. Yousuke from Gifu prefecture.



The effect on Ebemon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



EBEmon's ability to continuously make further improvements to itself was demonstrated at a certain country's "Area 51". The gun in its right hand is so high performing that it can even be regarded as its second brain; it instantly makes calculations for any location or target and fires its "Planet Destroyer Justice", which is always shot with 100% accuracy albeit somewhat forced. Even a shot that is considered to be a misfire is a way of showing and justifying that the outcome was within its calculations.

skills.name: Brain Rupture
skills.description: Destroys its opponent's brain with the gun in its left hand.

skills.name: Planet Destroyer
skills.description: Unlocks all of its accumulated power from the gun in its right hand, and is said to be able to destroy a single planet in an instant.

skills.name: Planet Destroyer Justice
skills.description: Instantly calculates the target's position and fires the gun on its right arm with 100% accuracy.

digimons.name: El Doradimon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Mutation Digimon that once wandered into the research data for ancient ruins on a neglected computer, and over a long period time unified with that data. Once its head, arms, and legs are retracted, it looks indistinguishable from the ruins of an ancient fortress. The enormous quantity of research data it holds has turned it into a slow-witted Digimon with a large build; nevertheless, bringing it down is likely a difficult task, even if it is attacked by scores of Digimon. It is the very definition of an impregnable Digimon. Its Special Moves are charging the opponent with its large body and breaking through, even while under attack (Golden Road), and striking with its gigantic foot, shaking the earth (Meteor Earthquake). Also, it can bite through the opponent with the power of its mighty jaws (Giant Nipper).

digimons.name: Erlangmon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA God Man Digimon born from the data of a certain warrior from Chinese legend. It acts in accordance with its conviction to rid all Digimon of their wicked hearts, and others refer to it as an upright Digimon due to the way it is honest.



A master that wields the Sān Jiān Liǎng Rèn Dāo as freely as its own limbs, it is also accompanied by its sentient treasure tool "Kōtenken"[N 1], which resembles the head of a giant dog, and cherishes it as its companion, appearing anywhere in an instant regardless of the situation when summoned, and excelling in surprise attacks. In addition, Erlangmon also has a transformation ability that is said to allow it to change into any Digimon. However, while it is capable of perfectly imitating their appearance, it cannot copy their abilities, so this transformation ability is often used for distractions or espionage.



Also, the third eye on its forehead has the power to see through the opponent's weak spots and wicked hearts, and together with its ever-changing tactics, it is extremely difficult for those opposing it, or those hiding wicked hearts to escape from its grasp.



Its Special Moves are swinging the Sān Jiān Liǎng Rèn Dāo around itself in one sweep, and eliminating enemies in its surroundings with a circular slash (Yōsen Enbu), and summoning Kōtenken to crunch the enemy's Digicore (Shōrai: Kōtenken).

digimons.name: Erlangmon: Blast Mode
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalThe awakened form Erlangmon puts on display after unleashing its power to the utmost limit only when eliminating enemies that it is incapable of defeating, even if they are observed with its third eye. It wears a transformed Kōtenken as armor, and the third eye above its head has the power to see through everything.



It fights while "observing" all things, including the opponent's thoughts as well, with its awakened third eye, and tears the enemy to pieces with the Sān Jiān Liǎng Rèn Dāo, which has turned into a gigantic energy form. It is safe to say that its fighting style, which can even foresee the future, is invincible. However, since Erlangmon's third eye is also its Digicore, it can be considered to be a dangerous form whose overwhelming strength comes at the expense of its Digicore being virtually exposed. Furthermore, the burden of managing its immense power and the information it observes is huge, so it cannot maintain this form for long.



Its Special Move is concentrating the energy surging from its third eye and shooting it clean through the enemy (Banshō Ikkan). In addition, it uses its unrivaled foresight to identify all of the enemy's behavioral patterns based on their physical and mental activity, and anticipate all of their attacks (Tengan Kensei).

digimons.name: Examon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Holy Knight Digimon which is one of the Digital World's sacred guardians, the "Royal Knights". As it is a Digimon which possesses an extraordinary data size, traditional digital tools were unable to completely render it, and its existence was discovered because it finally became possible to render it with the use of state-of-the-art digital tools. Though it belongs to the Royal Knights, it is simultaneously a being which stands at the top of all Dragon Digimon, and holds the alias of "Dragon Emperor". It possesses the gigantic, sentient wings "Caledfwlch" and the gigantic lance "Ambrosius". The Caledfwlch is a unique set of wings composed entirely of Chrome Digizoid, and at Caledfwlch's own will, it can at times change into wings for flight, or into a shield which defends Examon. The lance "Ambrosius" is loaded with special shells stocked with viruses which possess various effects, so Examon's attacks are quite diverse. Its Special Moves are stabbing the opponent with the Ambrosius and exploding all of its special shells, annihilating them from within (Avalon's Gate), and rocketing up to the exosphere and conducting a high-powered laser firing (Pendragon's Glory). Also, its "Dragonic Impact", in which it dives from the exosphere and performs a ramming attack shrouded in heat from friction with the atmosphere, mops up swaths of enemies with its accompanying shock wave.

digimons.name: Fenriloogamon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalFenriloogamon is an imaginary Digimon born from the "Daydream of a Digicore". It is a form that had even the Digicore's own creativity miraculously released through the Interface on its brow, and evolved. Possibly because it naturally possessed the data of the warg from real-world mythology within its Digicore, the form created by its Digicore is an "Ultimate Demon Beast", clad in silver armor and wielding an inexhaustible supply of magical power. The magical blue flames that envelop its whole body are kept under control at its own volition, and despite having an extremely high burning temperature, they normally flicker silently and beautifully. Its Special Moves are causing the blue flames that cover its body to explosively combust in an instant while howling, incinerating its surroundings (Ragnarök Howling), and tearing the opponent to pieces with laser-like magical flames that spurt from its limbs (Jötunheimr Gale). In addition, it can also summon a duplicate of itself made of magical flames called "Hróðvitnir", and since the duplicate uses the same techniques as Fenriloogamon, those who face it will struggle considerably.

digimons.name: Gabumon -Yujo no Kizuna-
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalThe strong bond between Gabumon and its Partner, it is a legendary, final evolution that was achieved after countless possibilities. The undying "Friendship" of its Partner turned into elegant armor which covers its body, and appears as proof of the trust coursing through both of them. It is able to fly by generating photon light wings on its back, but it can also transform into its Motorcycle Mode, which is its Partner's favorite vehicle, and ride fast together.



Its Special Moves are causing a downpour of iron to rain down from the Cowl Parts on its arms (Full Metal Machine Gun), and purging the Cowl Parts and unleashing an instant attack (Cool Edge). Furthermore, with its "Moon Tense", which fires laser beams in all directions, and its "Raddle Star", tracking weapons equipped with AI, it leaves no openings regardless of range.

digimons.name: Gaioumon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Dragon Man Digimon that increases its own strength as it wins battles, and is a subspecies of the Greymon-species, which are highly capable as Combat Species Digimon. Discovered within a neglected Oriental computer, there are many parts of its strength which are unmeasured, but it has been confirmed that it possesses an unbelievable combat record from its countless battles. Its uniquely shaped "Kikurin" swords, which it acquired due to its combat experience, leave behind eerie tracks of light, and it is said that anything that comes in contact with those tracks will be cut to pieces. Its Special Moves are the tracks of the Kikurin swords (Rinkazan), and concentrating all the energy within the atmosphere and then detonating it (Gaia Reactor). Also, it has acquired "Rinkageki", where it causes those eerie lights to converge all into one point, and using the two Kikurin swords fused together, shoots it at a distant enemy.

digimons.name: Gaioumon: Itto Mode
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalThe form of a Gaioumon defeated in battle that acquired new strength after unimaginable training. The oni data sleeping within its Digicore has awakened, and its fighting style has changed to Ittō-ryū. Having mastered "Tenrin Ittō-ryū", kenjutsu passed down in the Eastern Digital World, Gaioumon specializes in "silent" swordplay in which it instantly cuts down its opponents without even making a sound. Once prepared for battle, it is almost impossible to approach Gaioumon without leaving any openings.



Its Special Moves are restricting the opponent's movements with a tornado unleashed from the "Kikurin" (Senpū Baku), and charging at lightning speed and then bisecting them with the Kikurin, which surges with lightning (Kikurin Issen: Gouraizan). In addition, its secret technique "Touka Seihitsu", in which it cuts down enemies in its surroundings with a single stroke of its sword, is said to quietly bring the battle to an end without them even realizing that they have been cut by their adversary.

digimons.name: Gankoomon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Digimon who acceded to the "Royal Knights" because it is a Holy Knight Digimon. Although it is said to have taken up residence in the southwestern edges[N 1] of the Digital World, it rarely stays in the same place, so it journeys across the Digital World while going around and putting a stop to unusual phenomena and signs of chaos, taking along the next-generation Huckmon as its companion. Unlike the other Royal Knights who rarely show their faces, it actually steps down and acts, and there are many Digimon it counts as bosom friends. In order to pass on its own title as a Royal Knight to Huckmon, it assigns it rigorous trials, and entrusts Huckmon's training to the Sistermon sisters on the way. Due to its stubborn personality, its dealing with Huckmon in a severe manner is a cruel sort of kindness of wanting it to keep up with the other Royal Knights and become independent. "Hinukamuy", who is emerging from its body, is always there for Gankoomon, and although no words escape its lips, it gets involved without wasting its breath arguing. Its Special Moves are striking with all its strength at anyone and everyone who talks back to it (Tekken Seisai), and "Hinukamuy" loosing heaven's punishment at Gankoomon's harsh words, "Jishin! Kaminari! Kaji! Oyaji!" Furthermore, its "Chabudai Gaeshi" upends the ground as if it were a chabudai made of Chrome Digizoid, and the ground, being treated like a chabudai, becomes as hard as if it was made of Chrome Digizoid. "Hinukamuy" is itself in the process of evolving from an Adult, and it is said that when its power awakens, there couldn't exist any kind of Digimon to be recognized as a rival.

digimons.name: Gankoomon (X-Antibody)
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA Digimon who acceded to the "Royal Knights" because it is a Holy Knight Digimon. Although it is said to have taken up residence in the southwestern edges[N 1] of the Digital World, it rarely stays in the same place, so it journeys across the Digital World while going around and putting a stop to unusual phenomena and signs of chaos, taking along the next-generation Huckmon as its companion. Unlike the other Royal Knights who rarely show their faces, it actually steps down and acts, and there are many Digimon it counts as bosom friends.



 In order to pass on its own title as a Royal Knight to Huckmon, it assigns it rigorous trials, and entrusts Huckmon's training to the Sistermon sisters on the way. Due to its stubborn personality, its dealing with Huckmon in a severe manner is a cruel sort of kindness of wanting it to keep up with the other Royal Knights and become independent.



 "Hinukamuy", who is emerging from its body, is always there for Gankoomon, and although no words escape its lips, it gets involved without wasting its breath arguing.



Its Special Moves are striking with all its strength at anyone and everyone who talks back to it (Tekken Seisai), and "Hinukamuy" loosing heaven's punishment at Gankoomon's harsh words, "Jishin! Kaminari! Kaji! Oyaji!" Furthermore, its "Chabudai Gaeshi" flips the ground as if it was a chabudai made of Chrome Digizoid, and the ground being treated like a chabudai becomes as hard as if it was made of Chrome Digizoid. "Hinukamuy" is itself in the process of evolving from an Adult, and it is said that when its power awakens, there couldn't exist any kind of Digimon to be recognized as a rival.



The effect on Gankoomon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



By assimilating "Hinukamuy" into itself, it has manifested on Gankoomon's back along with the characters "Gankūmon". Should it fully unleash its surging aura, then that aura will transform into something resembling wings, exhibiting Gankoomon's power at its maximum. The Tetsu Geta it wears has become an offensive and defensive weapon that it holds in its hand, and deals heavy blows in its Signature Move "Tetsu Geta Harite"[N 2]. In addition, its final secret technique "Kyūkyoku Sengi Tengyouken" is a flawless, pulverizing uppercut that condenses all of its energy in its right hand, ignoring all defenses.

digimons.name: Giga Seadramon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalAs a successful elaboration on Metal Seadramon, it demonstrates the fastest speed of movement and strongest ability for interception under the sea. In order to further expand its sphere of influence, the Crack Team constructed this massive Digimon in absolute secrecy and endowed it with the ability to control the sea and possession of a cruising range which covers the vast Net Ocean. Its overall length exceeds even that of Whamon, and since Digimon belonging to the Crack Team, such as Chaosdramon, can be loaded in its interior, it is no longer a lone Digimon, and it seems possible to say that it is an assault landing ship for which it isn't known when and where it will appear on the Net Ocean, or when it will launch an attack. Its Special Moves are firing an energy torpedo from the cannon in its mouth (Giga Sea Destroyer), and strafing with countless anti-aircraft energy shells fired from the launchers on its back (Sky Wave).

digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA God Dragon Digimon with six hardened wings and a body that shines gold. On its arm is the proof that it is a holy Digimon, and it is considered a kind of Holy-species Digimon from where it wears its Holy Ring. Goddramon is one of the "Four Great Dragons Digimon"; the four of them are Goddramon, Holydramon, Qinglongmon, and Megidramon. Also, the tiny dragon Digimon sealed within the vambrace on Goddramon's right hand is called "Amon of Red Flame", who governs over "Destruction", and the one sealed within the vambrace on its left hand is called "Umon of Blue Thunder", who governs over "Regeneration". Its Special Move is exploding its holy spirit, instantly mowing down the opponents in every direction (God Flame).



The effect on Goddramon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



The fact that it was virtually unaffected by the X-Antibody meant that it had already manifested its latent abilities. Although there are no significant changes to Goddramon, who has continued to evolve throughout the history of the Digital World, its hidden grappling abilities have been drawn out. Portions of its head and chest have transformed into new armor, its hardened wings have made it easier to move about during hand-to-hand combat, and also form pairs to act as a shield. Despite reducing its holy power, its "God Fist", in which it sends out a fist-blow from its arm, blows ordinary Ultimate Digimon away without getting struck by it, and it came to be known as the "Sky-soaring, Strong-armed Fighting Dragon".

digimons.name: Grand Dracumon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Demon Beast Digimon that is considered the king of vampire Digimon. It has kept a castle in the Dark Area since ancient times, and it boasts of such power that even the Seven Great Demon Lords cannot interfere with it. It has a gentlemanly demeanor, and because of the "Charm" effect within the voice Grand Dracumon exudes, there have been anecdotes that it has led many of the Angel Digimon who have come to subdue it into falling down. It is told that it possesses an undying body, and although it is said that it is connected to the details of how the Dark Area came to be within the Digital World, or that it knows the truth of the mysterious evolution, "Death-X", because it's not an easy feat to even reach its castle in the first place, it can only be said that questioning it about these mysteries would be extremely difficult. Its Special Moves are instantly transforming all of the opponents into ice crystals (Crystal Revolution), and an evil eye that imprisons within darkness the hearts of the opponents that gaze at it (Eye of the Gorgon).

Its presence is concealed like dense fog, and it is the rarest species among Insect Digimon. It takes pride in being a Virus-species, and according to one theory, it is said to be a warrior in league with Black War Greymon, who preaches its own justice as a Virus-species. The "Gran Killers" on both of its arms are capable of damaging even the hardest of shells or metals, so it deepens the wounds and eventually brings down the enemy. Its Special Move is clamping the enemy with the enormous pincers on its head and cutting them to pieces (Grandis Scissor).

digimons.name: Gulfmon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalA Demon Beast Digimon of darkness that emerged from the depths of the Dark Area. This demon beast's towering size, supported by its four sturdy legs, is akin to that of a mountain, and its lower body houses a "Maw" large enough to swallow all. Not only that, it is said that the Maw's opening is connected to the depths of the Dark Area, and that those who are sucked in have their souls (Digicores) smashed to pieces and are no longer able to escape. Its power is mighty, and it is also said that it has the ability to destroy the world in seven days. Its Signature Move "Black Requiem" is a solemn voice heard singing out of nowhere, and it is said that Digimon who hear this song will soon die, and their data will never be able to be restored. Its Special Move is letting out the sorrowful cries of the dead from the gigantic Maw on its lower half, which bring death to all who hear them (Dead Scream).

digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA large Digimon with a massive quantity of firearms. Possessing outstanding firepower, Gundramon, Magna Kidmon and Beel Starmon are collectively known as the "Three Musketeers" by many Digimon. Furthermore, Gundramon is part of the Crack Team, and is positioned for use in combat just like Mugendramon. It is faster than Mugendramon, and has high maneuverability such that it instantly moves within firing range. The burning smell of cartridges permeates through the 100% full metal comprising its body, so it is a bitter, hard-boiled Digimon.



Its Special Moves are picking off the enemy's vitals with the six-chambered revolvers on both of its hands (Der Blitz), pinning the enemy to the ground with its feet and shooting them at point-blank range (Platzenkreuz), in addition, it has "Gewaltschwärmer", a volley fired in all directions.

digimons.name: Habakirimon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA bizarre God Man Digimon with four arms. It is a being with godlike power that appears in folktales, passed down solely through oral tradition, within a certain school of swordsmanship in the Eastern Digital World. It is widely recognized that in ancient times, a Digimon—known as the "God of Destruction" in the Eastern Digital World—destroyed and recreated the world, but according to oral tradition, the God of Destruction had a trusted retainer, and it is said that Habakirimon was that retainer. Serving its master, Habakirimon is said to have been involved in the destruction of the world, making full use of its immense power. While it is a swordsman that freely wields its gigantic seven-branched sword, the "Futsushimitama-no-tsurugi", it also specializes in close-range combat that takes advantage of its four arms. As a Digimon, it possesses exceptional offensive power, but when fighting alongside its master, it seems capable of exhibiting combat abilities on par with its master, albeit temporarily, due to it having the blessing of the God of Destruction.



Its Special Move "Habakiri" is a slash attack unleashed by concentrating the aura surging from its entire body into the Futsushimitama-no-tsurugi, and is powerful enough to incinerate not only the target, but their surroundings as well. Also, the Futsushimitama-no-tsurugi can be split into seven blades, and the technique in which Habakirimon manipulates the seven blades through its thoughts and slashes from all directions is called "Aramasa".



It is told that Habakirimon's master, the God of Destruction, incorporated the name "Habakiri" into its Special Move as a reward for its loyalty, but it is unknown whether this is true or not. Although the God of Destruction, who recreated the world and lost their powers, disappeared somewhere, it is said that even to this day, Habakirimon continues to wait in its castle for its master's return.

digimons.name: Heavy Leomon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA Machine Digimon with the heaviest build, rare even among the various Leomon families. Its power is the greatest among Machine-types thanks to its charging power, so it is difficult to stop Heavy Leomon from charging head-on. The source of Heavy Leomon's charging power is its passionate fighting spirit, and its strength doubles the more its fighting spirit burns. In addition, unlike a weapon made solely for fighting, it has a kind heart in that it also carries out rescue operations, so if there is a Digimon that needs help, it will firstly rush over to them, and then remove any obstacles using its prided power.



While it is brimming with passionate fighting spirit in battle, it analyzes the opponent and acts with composure. It shoots at long range, firing a barrage with the "Barrage Sweeper" autocannon deployed from its left shoulder, and skillfully uses its "Resting Burner", a mid-range attack where it expels ultra-high temperature flames from the lion armor on its chest, and "Sonic Excavator", a very-close range technique where it impales the enemy by launching its Pile Bunker while charging with its fighting spirit at its maximum, for different proposes, and achieves victory steadily with tactics that leave no openings regardless of long, mid, or close-range combat.

digimons.name: Hexeblaumon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA legendary Magic Knight Digimon that only those who have mastered ice sorcery (a high-level programming language) are said to be able to evolve to. It protected other Digimon until the very end when the Digital World was visited by an ice age long ago, and was later rumored to have moved to another dimension, "Witchelny".



It excels in the art of manipulating the cold, and creates various things with ice. It starts with weapons such as swords and hammers, and then other tools such as restraints that restrict the enemy's movements, and is also capable of erecting a barrier to defend itself from attacks, so it is definitely an ice professional.



Its Special Moves are spreading cold air over a wide range, instantly transforming anyone that draws near into statues of ice (Summon Frost), and causing countless ice swords to fall down like a blizzard (Hecto Edge Blizzard). In addition, its final secret technique "Absolute Blast" unleashes an absolute zero wave from the dragon jaws on its left shoulder which shatters everything.

digimons.name: Hi Andromon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalAn Ultimate Cyborg Digimon that was perfected by improving the incomplete Andromon. The percentage of Chrome Digizoid parts which compose its body has increased, and it is impossible to miss the extent of its gains in offensive and defensive power from this, compared to Andromon. Additionally, while the Bio-Synapse circuits which govern its thinking were incomplete when it was an Andromon, by adding Chrome Digizoid parts to them, it has become self-aware and thus capable of executing its objectives. Because it is both a Vaccine-species and a Cyborg, its attacks against Virus-types are not only scarily accurate but also intense. Its Special Move is taking the fission energy emanating from the blue neutron-control turbine on its right shoulder and the fusion energy emanating from the red atom-control turbine on its left shoulder, combining them at the tip of its hands, and then firing off a beam which annihilates the opponent (Atomic Ray).

digimons.name: Holydramon (X-Antibody)
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalThe ultimate form of god beast Digimon. Its heroic appearance is reminiscent of a ruler of the sky. There are few who have seen its appearance, and it has not even been entirely confirmed where it usually is. However, it is said that it suddenly appeared out of nowhere once when a gigantic evil energy was generated in the Digital World, and laid waste to the evil with its vast power. Its Special Move is striking the opponent with the light energy of all justice (Holy Flame). Those who suffer this technique have their forms instantaneously erased. Also, Holydramon is one of the Four Great Dragons.



The effect on Holydramon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



The fact that it was virtually unaffected by the X-Antibody meant that it had already manifested its latent abilities. Although there are no visible changes to Holydramon, who has continued to evolve throughout the history of the Digital World, the wild, draconic ferocity it had restrained has been completely drawn out. When facing evil Digimon, it smashes them to smithereens with its brutal, tremendous fighting style, and then erases them in the blink of an eye with its enormous light energy of justice (Holy Blaze), and is starting to become feared as a vengeful god.

skills.name: Holy Flame
skills.description: Shoots a spiral of holy fire from its mouth.

skills.name: Holy Blaze
skills.description: Instantly erases the opponent with enormous light energy.

digimons.name: Hououmon (X-Antibody)
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA holy Digimon that possesses four wings that shine gold. It is the head of all Bird Digimon, and is said to be the one that presides over Holy-species Digimon. While Holydramon is the ultimate form of Beast Digimon, Hououmon is the ultimate form of Bird Digimon. As proof that it is a Holy-species Digimon, it draws holy power from where it holds its two "Holy Rings", and it is understood that the power possessed by Hououmon is unfathomable. Its Special Move is solemnly flapping its four wings, causing it to rain golden grains (Starlight Explosion). It is said that those who suffer this technique have all of their wickedness purified.



The effect on Hououmon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



It now has twelve "Holy Rings", and gives off power so sacred that not even ordinary Angel-species Digimon are a match for it. The divine aura covering its body is the largest defensive "Firewall", and so it is immune to all viruses. It is said that if a Digimon touches one of its falling feathers, they will be protected from the clutches of evil.



Its Special Move "Starlight Explosion" has become even more powerful due to the increase in its holy power.

skills.name: Starlight Explosion
skills.description: Rains golden grains from its wings that purify evil, or explodes with light.

digimons.name: Huanglongmon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalRuling over the "Four Holy Beasts" who protect the east, west, south, and north of the Digital World, it is an emperor Digimon who is enshrined in the center and rules the "land (world)". An angel Digimon that descended in the distant past had sealed it in the deepest, darkest place within the earth. The Four Holy Beasts lost their ruler because of this, causing a struggle for hegemony among them, but an equilibrium is maintained at present. It is a being of both good and evil, and is called the "Taiji" of light and darkness. It has eight eyes and twelve external Digicores, and its gigantic body is covered in scales of the special "Huanglong Ore" that boasts of absolute hardness, so inflicting even a single wound upon it is impossible. Its Special Moves are continuously disassembling everything in the Digital World into the two extremes of light and darkness throughout eternity, until eventually it turns all to nothingness (Taikyoku), and generating a gigantic typhoon of an earthflow on the scale of a natural disaster (Oukai).



Huanglong Ore



As the ore from which "Chrondigizoit" is derived, it is a virtual ore that boasts of absolute hardness. Only Huanglong Ore is able to actually scratch Huanglong Ore, and because there is no method available to compare it with other minerals and metals, it is impossible to measure its hardness. Despite this extreme hardness, its weight is extremely great, so it is not suitable for things like weapons or armor. It is also highly scarce, and can only be found deep underground. Not only that, it is said that it requires many, many years—far more than since the age of myth—to unify Huanglong Ore with living things, and at present no other Digimon has been discovered to have unified with this super-hard ore besides Huanglongmon. As Chrondigizoit resolves these downsides, one could say it is an excellent rare metal.

digimons.name: Hydramon
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalA gigantic Plant Digimon that primarily takes root in swampland. It constantly secretes a highly-toxic liquid from its whole body, which it mercilessly uses to dissolve anyone that touches it, and preys on them. Also, it has a habit of expelling large amounts of that liquid from its abdomen, melting the ground and creating swamps to expand its nest. These swamps disturb the surrounding ecosystem, so if you see ominous flowers that have grown abnormally, it is a sign to be cautious.



Its Special Moves are spewing a poison gas from the mouth on its abdomen that has the same components as its highly-toxic liquid (Biotoxin), and randomly firing beams from its three heads (Intense Lamptḗr). It completely destroys the enemy as well as the earth with its "Division Break", in which it causes the vines that it spreads into the ground to shake violently, creating fissures.

It is an ultimate Digimon that acquired a great intellect by changing from the difficult-to-control Dragon Mode to a human form. It is said that the power to destroy a planet dwells in its attacks. Its Special Moves are the "Positron Laser" equipped to its right arm, and inserting the Positron Laser into the dragon-face on its chest, then emitting all of its body's energy as a destructive energy wave (Giga Death). Its power is ten times that of Dragon Mode's "Mega Death". Also, when it awakens to perfect justice, it is able to transform into an even further Mode.

However, all of the details of that era are a mystery, and if research into Digimon and the Digital World progresses, it is likely that they will eventually be clarified. Its Special Move is cutting the opponent in two with a single stroke of its ultimate "Omega Blade" sword, resetting and clearing their configuration data.

digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalThe crystal in Savior Huckmon's chest began to shine as it surpassed Perfect to reach its Ultimate form: a Holy Knight Digimon that acquired the title of a "Royal Knight", the highest rank of Network Security. It is endowed with the ability to sense the unusual phenomena and signs of chaos that occur all over the Digital World, and is the first of any of the Royal Knights to come running. Rather than act independently, it tends to employ teamwork such as making a coordinated response with nearby Digimon and the Sistermons, which is rare for a Royal Knight; it does so due to its trust in others and so that it will not become overconfident in its abilities. By observing and learning from the Hinukamuy of its mentor Gankoomon, Jesmon also acquired the trio "Atho", "René", and "Por" as part of its ascetic training. They are able to move and act independently under Jesmon's instructions, and boast formidable behavioral abilities such as landing direct attacks on the enemy, the protection of Jesmon, and the rescue of other Digimon. Its Special Moves are slicing the enemy to pieces with the blades on its arms while moving at high speed (Tekken Seibai), and an omnidirectional counter technique alongside "Atho", "René", and "Por" that meets every enemy attack with their nine blades (Schwertgeist). Its "Aus Generics" enables it to temporarily rewrite its own data and perform actions that transcend the laws of nature, leaving its physical abilities unbound by the laws of the Digital World and thus allowing Jesmon to overpower any enemy without taking a single scratch.

digimons.name: JESmon (X-Antibody)
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalThe crystal in Savior Huckmon's chest began to shine as it surpassed Perfect to reach its Ultimate form: a Holy Knight Digimon that acquired the title of a "Royal Knights", the highest rank of Network Security. It is endowed with the ability to sense the unusual phenomena and signs of chaos that occur all over the Digital World, and is the first of any of the Royal Knights to come running. Rather than act independently, it tends to employ teamwork such as making a coordinated response with nearby Digimon and the Sistermons, which is rare for a Royal Knight; it does so due to its trust in others and so that it will not become overconfident in its abilities. By observing and learning from the Hinukamuy of its mentor Gankoomon, JESmon also acquired the trio "Atho", "René", and "Por" as part of its ascetic training. They are able to move and act independently under JESmon's instructions, and boast formidable behavioral abilities such as landing direct attacks on the enemy, the protection of JESmon, and the rescue of other Digimon.



The effect on JESmon's Digicore due to the X-Antibody



The X-Antibody has transformed it into a form further specializing in offense, and turned the armor covering its body into blades. The multiple blades it has newly equipped are all capable of independent movement, giving JESmon the attack power to one-sidedly overwhelm the opponent in single combat. Not only that, its three programs "Atho", "René", and "Por" have all awakened and unified as the single Tactical Arms, giving rise to a new battle style that is aimed at all directions, not leaving a single spot untouched.



Its Special Moves are shooting out its Tactical Arms, pummeling the opponent with an iron fist that would make Gankoomon proud (Tekken Danzai), and firing off the swords all over its body at the opponent, unleashing a combo-attack with the greatswords on both of its arms (Schwertflügel). Furthermore, the "Kyūkyoku Senjin Seibaken" it pulls out from the Digicore in its chest is a non-lethal trump card, destroying only the fighting spirit of any opponent it cuts, leaving them unable to battle.

digimons.name: JESmon GX
digimons.description:
⇨ OriginalThe final form of JESmon that awakened to its true power by undergoing harsh training with Gankoomon, and fully mastering it. Its form, in which its whole body is brimming with fighting spirit and sense of justice, is clad in the red color of blazing flames.



The "Unlimitive Gauntlet", which is now its main weapon, is a piece of equipment used for both offense and defense that switches between its respective Sword, Knuckle, and Shield Modes depending on the situation.



The Tactical Arms has turned into a wing-shaped energy construct by evolving further, and its flight capability has also increased rapidly.



In its Arms state, it unleashes a subluminal combo-attack that succeeds Gankoomon's secret technique (Seiken Meppa).



Its final secret technique is JESmon GX itself becoming the vessel for its "Knights' Intruder", the fourteenth Ultimate-Battle-Blade that should not exist, by concentrating the energy of the Royal Knights, turning into an offensive judgment sword that instantly erases the opponent no matter how strong they are.

digimons.name: Jet Mervamon
digimons.description: ⇨ OriginalAn Enhancement type that resulted when Mervamon, for whom the land was its main battlefield, gained the flight abilities of Sparrowmon and the ability to sprint through both land and air. Its battle strategy has also undergone a complete change; it specializes in executing disruptive tactics that not only utilize its charm, but also its hit-and-run attacks that make use of its high-speed flight ability, and are powered up as it accelerates. Jet Mervamon gives of an air of grace as it soars calmly, emitting a lovely aroma that can be felt for an instant by those it flies past. However, that elegance vanishes once it increases its flight speed; another side of it surfaces as it becomes unstoppable due the thrill gotten from gaining speed... Its Special Moves are firing beams with great piercing power (Heartbreak Shot), drawing a circular trail by spinning at high speed and summoning the "Jashin Ouroboros" from it to sink the opponent into hell (Ouroboros Gate), as well as its trump card for its disruptive tactics, "Spicy Hard Love", in which it fires a "Random Laser" barrage all over and does a sweep with its "Medullia" to break through the enemy lines. Furthermore, its "Sexy Dynamites", in which it forcefully slams its bottom into the enemy, is powerful enough to cause a great explosion, and any enemy that is hit by this attack will collapse on the spot in bliss.
